jobs.description:
Introduction
 Within the CERN Engineering department (EN), the Cooling and Ventilation (EN-CV) group is responsible for the design, the building, the operation and the maintenance of the cooling and ventilation plants for large energy physics accelerators, experiments and technical facilities. The EN-CV group pursues sustainable cooling and ventilation systems enhancing energy saving and recovery.
 You will join the PSM Section (EN-CV-PSM), which is in charge of the operation and maintenance of the cooling and ventilation systems of CERN’s accelerator complex and experimental areas. The activity includes the work site supervision for installation work and commissioning of new systems, upgrade of existing systems and consolidation of old systems.
 Are you a qualified technician, specialised in industrial cooling, ventilation & refrigeration systems? Contribute your skill and experience to the operation and maintenance of complex cooling plants in a unique environment hosting some of the world’s most complex technical installations. Join CERN’s Cooling and Ventilation operation team. Take part!
 Functions

• Plan (by using the CMMS system), coordinate, supervise, check and perform preventive and corrective maintenance activities on cooling and ventilation systems.

• Perform operation activities to ensure appropriate running of the cooling, ventilation & refrigeration systems.

• Ensure regular liaison with clients for all matters related to equipment under your responsibility.

• Propose and define the most appropriate solution to meet user needs in case of modification or renovation works.

• Technically coordinate contractors’ activities for maintenance and installation work in compliance with contractual clauses and technical standards.

• Contribute to projects from the design phase until test and commissioning of new cooling and ventilation systems.

• Ensure that the technical documentation is kept up-to-date and compliant with the quality standards.

• Ensure the respect of safety rules for all interventions.

• Follow up and regularly report on activities progress, schedule and costs.

Higher technical diploma or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Refrigeration and / or Electromechanics, or a related field.
 Having obtained the fluid handling permit, or equivalent is considered an advantage.
 Experience:

• Experience in maintenance, operation, and installation work on cooling, ventilation, and industrial systems.

• Experience in the technical coordination of external contractors.

• Experience in the use of CMMS tools.

• Experience in low-voltage electrical systems.

• Initial experience in compressed air systems.

• Experience in the operation and maintenance of refrigeration systems.

• Demonstrated experience in installation works.
 Technical competencies:

• Operation and maintenance of HVAC plants and networks.

• Operation and maintenance of cooling water systems.

• Design, construction, operation and maintenance of detector cooling systems.

• Operation and maintenance of electrical circuits and networks.

• Experience in work site supervision and as technical supervisor of contractors would be an advantage.
 Behavioural competencies:

• Achieving Results: delivering high quality work on time and fulfilling expectations.

• Communicating Effectively: expressing opinions, ideas and suggestions with conviction and in a logical/structured manner; keeping to the point.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: being able to deal with ambiguous or unpredictable situations.

• Solving Problems: anticipating obstacles; assessing alternative solutions in order to have a fall-back plan.

• Working in Teams: working well in groups and readily fitting into a team; participating fully and taking an active role in team activities.
 Language skills:
 Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
 Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
 This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 18.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST .
 Employment Conditions
 Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
 Working Hours: 40 hours per week
 Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
 This position involves:

• Participation in a regular stand-by duty, including nights, Sundays and official holidays.

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Shift work, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Exposure to asbestos.

• Exposure to lead.

• Radiation worker, category A.

• Exposure to risk of falling from heights during scaffolding assembly and dismantling operations.

• Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions.

• Shift work.

• Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
 Job grade: 3-4
 Job reference: EN-CV-PSM-2026-122-LD
 Field of work: Mechanical Engineering
 Benchmark Job Title: Mechanical Technician

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
 Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
 Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
 If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
 More information about us, here: careers.cern

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione All'interno del reparto CERN Engineering (EN), il gruppo Cooling and Ventilation (EN-CV) è responsabile per la progettazione, l'edificio, il funzionamento e la manutenzione degli impianti di raffreddamento e ventilazione per grandi acceleratori di fisica dell'energia, esperimenti e impianti tecnici. Il gruppo EN-CV persegue sistemi di raffreddamento e ventilazione sostenibili che migliorano il risparmio energetico e il recupero. Vi unirete alla sezione PSM (EN-CV-PSM), che è responsabile del funzionamento e della manutenzione dei sistemi di raffreddamento e ventilazione delle aree complesse e sperimentali dell’acceleratore del CERN. L'attività comprende la supervisione del sito di lavoro per l'installazione e la messa in servizio di nuovi sistemi, l'aggiornamento dei sistemi esistenti e il consolidamento di vecchi sistemi. Sei un tecnico qualificato, specializzato in sistemi di raffreddamento industriale, ventilazione e refrigerazione? Contribuisci la tua abilità e la tua esperienza al funzionamento e alla manutenzione di complessi impianti di raffreddamento in un ambiente unico che ospita alcune delle installazioni tecniche più complesse del mondo. Unisciti al team operativo di raffreddamento e ventilazione del CERN. Prendi parte! Funzioni
• Pianificare (utilizzando il sistema CMMS), coordinare, supervisionare, controllare ed eseguire attività di manutenzione preventiva e correttiva sui sistemi di raffreddamento e ventilazione.
• Eseguire le attività di funzionamento per garantire un corretto funzionamento dei sistemi di raffreddamento, ventilazione e refrigerazione.
• Assicurare un collegamento regolare con i clienti per tutte le questioni relative alle attrezzature sotto la vostra responsabilità.
• Proporre e definire la soluzione più appropriata per soddisfare le esigenze degli utenti in caso di modifiche o lavori di ristrutturazione.
• Coordinare tecnicamente le attività degli appaltatori per lavori di manutenzione e installazione in conformità alle clausole contrattuali e agli standard tecnici.
• Contribuire a progetti dalla fase di progettazione fino alla prova e messa in servizio di nuovi sistemi di raffreddamento e ventilazione.
• Assicurarsi che la documentazione tecnica sia mantenuta aggiornata e conforme agli standard di qualità.
• Assicurare il rispetto delle norme di sicurezza per tutti gli interventi.
• Seguire e regolarmente riferire sui progressi, programmi e costi delle attività. Diploma tecnico superiore o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo della refrigerazione e / o elettromeccanica, o un campo correlato. Avendo ottenuto il permesso di manipolazione del fluido, o equivalente è considerato un vantaggio. Esperienza:
• Esperienza in manutenzione, funzionamento e lavori di installazione su raffreddamento, ventilazione e sistemi industriali.
• Esperienza nel coordinamento tecnico degli imprenditori esterni.
• Esperienza nell'uso di strumenti CMMS.
• Esperienza nei sistemi elettrici a bassa tensione.
• Esperienza iniziale nei sistemi di aria compressa.
• Esperienza nel funzionamento e manutenzione dei sistemi di refrigerazione.
• Esperienza dimostrata nei lavori di installazione. Competenze tecniche:
• Funzionamento e manutenzione di impianti e reti HVAC.
• Funzionamento e manutenzione dei sistemi di raffreddamento dell'acqua.
• Progettazione, costruzione, funzionamento e manutenzione di sistemi di raffreddamento rilevatori.
• Funzionamento e manutenzione di circuiti elettrici e reti.
• L'esperienza nella supervisione del sito di lavoro e come supervisore tecnico degli appaltatori sarebbe un vantaggio. Competenze comportamentali:
• Ottenere risultati: fornire lavoro di alta qualità nel tempo e soddisfare le aspettative.
• Comunicare efficacemente: esprimere opinioni, idee e suggerimenti con convinzione e in modo logico/strutturato; mantenere al punto.
• Dimostrare Flessibilità: poter affrontare situazioni ambigue o imprevedibili.
• Risolvere i problemi: anticipare gli ostacoli; valutare soluzioni alternative per avere un piano di riduzione.
• Lavorare in team: lavorare bene in gruppi e adattarsi prontamente a un team; partecipare pienamente e assumere un ruolo attivo nelle attività del team. descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction
Within the CERN Engineering department (EN), the Cooling and Ventilation (EN-CV) group is responsible for the design, the building, the operation and the maintenance of the cooling and ventilation plants for large energy physics accelerators, experiments and technical facilities. The EN-CV group pursues sustainable cooling and ventilation systems enhancing energy saving and recovery.
You will join the PSM Section (EN-CV-PSM), which is in charge of the operation and maintenance of the cooling and ventilation systems of CERN’s accelerator complex and experimental areas. The activity includes the work site supervision for installation work and commissioning of new systems, upgrade of existing systems and consolidation of old systems.
Are you a qualified technician, specialised in industrial cooling, ventilation & refrigeration systems? Contribute your skill and experience to the operation and maintenance of complex cooling plants in a unique environment hosting some of the world’s most complex technical installations. Join CERN’s Cooling and Ventilation operation team. Take part!
Functions

• Plan (by using the CMMS system), coordinate, supervise, check and perform preventive and corrective maintenance activities on cooling and ventilation systems.

• Perform operation activities to ensure appropriate running of the cooling, ventilation & refrigeration systems.

• Ensure regular liaison with clients for all matters related to equipment under your responsibility.

• Propose and define the most appropriate solution to meet user needs in case of modification or renovation works.

• Technically coordinate contractors’ activities for maintenance and installation work in compliance with contractual clauses and technical standards.

• Contribute to projects from the design phase until test and commissioning of new cooling and ventilation systems.

• Ensure that the technical documentation is kept up-to-date and compliant with the quality standards.

• Ensure the respect of safety rules for all interventions.

• Follow up and regularly report on activities progress, schedule and costs.

Higher technical diploma or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Refrigeration and / or Electromechanics, or a related field.
Having obtained the fluid handling permit, or equivalent is considered an advantage.
Experience:

• Experience in maintenance, operation, and installation work on cooling, ventilation, and industrial systems.

• Experience in the technical coordination of external contractors.

• Experience in the use of CMMS tools.

• Experience in low-voltage electrical systems.

• Initial experience in compressed air systems.

• Experience in the operation and maintenance of refrigeration systems.

• Demonstrated experience in installation works.
Technical competencies:

• Operation and maintenance of HVAC plants and networks.

• Operation and maintenance of cooling water systems.

• Design, construction, operation and maintenance of detector cooling systems.

• Operation and maintenance of electrical circuits and networks.

• Experience in work site supervision and as technical supervisor of contractors would be an advantage.
Behavioural competencies:

• Achieving Results: delivering high quality work on time and fulfilling expectations.

• Communicating Effectively: expressing opinions, ideas and suggestions with conviction and in a logical/structured manner; keeping to the point.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: being able to deal with ambiguous or unpredictable situations.

• Solving Problems: anticipating obstacles; assessing alternative solutions in order to have a fall-back plan.

• Working in Teams: working well in groups and readily fitting into a team; participating fully and taking an active role in team activities.
Language skills:
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 18.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST .
Employment Conditions
Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
This position involves:

• Participation in a regular stand-by duty, including nights, Sundays and official holidays.

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Shift work, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Exposure to asbestos.

• Exposure to lead.

• Radiation worker, category A.

• Exposure to risk of falling from heights during scaffolding assembly and dismantling operations.

• Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions.

• Shift work.

• Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
Job grade: 3-4
Job reference: EN-CV-PSM-2026-122-LD
Field of work: Mechanical Engineering
Benchmark Job Title: Mechanical Technician

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
More information about us, here: careers.cern

jobs.description:
In this role, you will contribute to a major upgrade program of CERN's accelerator complex by maintaining, replacing, and installing beam instrumentation systems. Your day-to-day work involves removing and installing equipment components across accelerator facilities, tracking interventions using CERN's management tools, and coordinating on-site progress with engineers and technicians
 Your responsibilities

• Remove equipment components for refurbishment or replacement.

• Install new instrumentation systems and upgrades throughout the accelerator complex.

• Track your tasks using CERN's management tools and provide updates in team meetings.

• Coordinate with engineers, technicians, and other groups to keep everyone informed of on-site progress.

• Work across different areas of CERN's accelerator facilities, following all safety protocols and ensuring precise, clean execution of technical interventions.
 Your profile

• Comfortable using standard hand tools and basic technical equipment.

• No prior experience with particle accelerators or beam instrumentation required. We will train you on CERN-specific systems.
 Skills

• Quick learner comfortable adapting to new tools, procedures, and technical environments.

• Attention to detail and careful approach when working with sensitive electronic and electromechanical equipment.

• Good communicator who works well with diverse technical teams.

• Practical problem-solving mindset.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Mechanical or Electrical (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is a general secondary education diploma .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants with a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree are not eligible.

Job closing date: 02.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST.

Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
 Working hours: 40 hours per week
 Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
 Target start date: 01-December-2026
 This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
 Job reference: SY-BI-BL-2026-176-GRAE
 Field of work: Electrical or Electronics Engineering
 Benchmark job: 300060 - Electronics Technician

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend of 4687 Swiss Francs per month (tax free).

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
 Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
 Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
 If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
 More information about us, here: careers.cern

descriptionByLocale.it:
In questo ruolo, contribuirai ad un importante programma di aggiornamento del complesso dell'acceleratore del CERN mantenendo, sostituendo e installando sistemi di strumentazione del fascio. Il vostro lavoro quotidiano comporta la rimozione e l'installazione di componenti di apparecchiature attraverso impianti di acceleratore, il monitoraggio degli interventi utilizzando gli strumenti di gestione del CERN, e il coordinamento dei progressi in loco con ingegneri e tecnici Le tue responsabilità
• Rimuovere i componenti dell'attrezzatura per la ristrutturazione o la sostituzione.
• Installare nuovi sistemi di strumentazione e aggiornamenti in tutto il complesso acceleratore.
• Traccia le tue attività utilizzando gli strumenti di gestione del CERN e fornisce aggiornamenti nelle riunioni di squadra.
• Coordinate con ingegneri, tecnici e altri gruppi per tenere tutti informati dei progressi in loco.
• Lavorare in diverse aree dell'acceleratore del CERN, seguendo tutti i protocolli di sicurezza e garantendo un'esecuzione precisa e pulita degli interventi tecnici. Il tuo profilo
• Confortevole utilizzando utensili manuali standard e attrezzature tecniche di base.
• Nessuna esperienza precedente con acceleratori di particelle o strumentazione del fascio richiesto. Ti alleneremo sui sistemi specifici del CERN. Competenze
• Rapido apprendimento confortevole adattandosi a nuovi strumenti, procedure e ambienti tecnici.
• Attenzione ai dettagli e attento approccio quando si lavora con apparecchiature elettroniche e elettromeccaniche sensibili.
• Buon comunicatore che lavora bene con diversi team tecnici.
• Pratico set mentale problem solving.
• Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese. Criteri di ammissibilità:
• Sei un cittadino di uno Stato membro del CERN o di uno Stato membro associato .
• Con il termine di applicazione, si dispone di un massimo di due anni di esperienza professionale dalla laurea in meccanica o elettrica (o un campo correlato) e la vostra più alta qualifica educativa è un diploma di istruzione secondaria generale.
• Non hai mai avuto un contratto di laurea o di socio del CERN.
• I candidati con una laurea, Master o dottorato di ricerca non sono ammissibili. Data di chiusura del lavoro: 02.08.2026 alle 23:59 CEST. Durata del contratto: 24 mesi, con una possibile estensione fino a 36 mesi massimo. Orario di lavoro: 40 ore settimanali Flessibilità del lavoro: Fully Onsite Data di inizio obiettivo: 01-dicembre-2026 Questa posizione comporta:
• Lavoro nelle aree di radiazione.
• Interventi in impianti sotterranei.
• Una patente di guida valida.
• Lavorare durante le notti, la domenica e le vacanze ufficiali, quando richiesto dalle esigenze dell'Organizzazione. Riferimento del lavoro: SY-BI-BL-2026-176-GRAE Campo di lavoro: Ingegneria elettrica o elettronica Benchmark job: 300060 - Electronics Technician Vantaggi globali
• Sospensione mensile di 4687 franchi svizzeri al mese (tassa libera).
• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.
• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.
• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.
• Un pacchetto di trasferimento (concessione di installazione e spese di viaggio) a seconda delle vostre circostanze individuali.
• Possibilità di estendere il contratto fino a 36 mesi.
• On-the-job e formazione formale, comprese le lezioni di lingua. Panoramica del CERN - Scopri un mondo in cui l'impossibile è reso possibile! Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano. Ogni giorno affrontiamo nuove entusiasmanti sfide e opportunità per contribuire alla ricerca all'avanguardia che plasma la nostra comprensione dell'universo. Incontriamo queste sfide attraverso le diverse prospettive all'interno dei nostri team, assicurando che ogni contributo sia valutato e guida il nostro senso condiviso di inclusione e scopo. La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione, e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e il successo continuo. Se siete pronti a far parte di una comunità dinamica e inclusiva che spinge i confini della conoscenza, il CERN è il luogo in cui la vostra curiosità e abilità possono prosperare. Fate parte della nostra missione per scoprire cosa sta nel cuore dell'universo! Partita! Maggiori informazioni su di noi, qui: careers.cern

descriptionByLocale.de:
In dieser Rolle tragen Sie zu einem umfangreichen Upgrade-Programm des CERN-Beschleunigerkomplexes bei, indem Sie Strahlinstrumentierungssysteme warten, ersetzen und installieren. Ihre tägliche Arbeit umfasst das Entfernen und Installieren von Ausrüstungskomponenten in Beschleunigeranlagen, das Nachverfolgen von Eingriffen mit den Management-Tools des CERN und die Koordination des Fortschritts vor Ort mit Ingenieuren und Technikern. Ihre Verantwortung
• Geräteteile für die Renovierung oder den Austausch entfernen.
• Installieren Sie neue Messsysteme und Upgrades im gesamten Beschleunigerkomplex.
• Verfolgen Sie Ihre Aufgaben mit den Management-Tools des CERN und stellen Sie Updates in Teambesprechungen bereit.
• Koordinieren Sie sich mit Ingenieuren, Technikern und anderen Gruppen, um alle über den Fortschritt vor Ort zu informieren.
• Arbeiten Sie in verschiedenen Bereichen der CERN-Beschleunigeranlagen, befolgen Sie alle Sicherheitsprotokolle und gewährleisten Sie eine präzise, saubere Durchführung technischer Eingriffe. Dein Profil
• Komfortabel mit Standard-Handwerkzeugen und grundlegender technischer Ausrüstung.
• Keine Vorkenntnisse mit Teilchenbeschleunigern oder Strahlinstrumenten erforderlich. Wir schulen Sie zu CERN-spezifischen Systemen. Fähigkeiten
• Schneller Lernender passt sich bequem an neue Werkzeuge, Verfahren und technische Umgebungen an.
• Aufmerksamkeit für Details und sorgfältige Herangehensweise bei der Arbeit mit empfindlichen elektronischen und elektromechanischen Geräten.
• Guter Kommunikator, der gut mit verschiedenen technischen Teams zusammenarbeitet.
• Praktische Problemlösungsmentalität.
• Englisch gesprochen und geschrieben, mit der Verpflichtung, Französisch zu lernen. Förderkriterien:
• Sie sind Staatsangehöriger eines CERN-Mitglieds oder assoziierten Mitgliedstaats.
• Bis zum Bewerbungsschluss haben Sie seit dem Abschluss in Mechanical oder Electrical (oder einem verwandten Bereich) maximal zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung und Ihre höchste Bildungsqualifikation ist ein allgemeines Sekundarschulabschluss.
• Sie hatten noch nie einen CERN-Stipendiaten- oder Absolventenvertrag.
• Bewerber mit einem Bachelor-, Master- oder PhD-Abschluss sind nicht förderfähig. Arbeitsabschluss: 02.08.2026 um 23:59 Uhr MESZ. Vertragsdauer: 24 Monate, mit einer möglichen Verlängerung auf maximal 36 Monate. Arbeitszeit: 40 Stunden pro Woche Arbeitsplatzflexibilität: Vollständig vor Ort Startdatum: 01-Dezember-2026 Diese Position umfasst:
• Arbeiten in Strahlungsgebieten.
• Eingriffe in unterirdische Anlagen.
• Ein gültiger Führerschein.
• Arbeiten in den Nächten, Sonntagen und offiziellen Feiertagen, wenn es die Bedürfnisse der Organisation erfordern. Berufsbezeichnung: SY-BI-BL-2026-176-GRAE Arbeitsgebiet: Elektrotechnik oder Elektronik Benchmark-Job: 300060 - Elektroniktechniker Globale Vorteile
• Ein monatliches Stipendium von 4687 Schweizer Franken pro Monat (steuerfrei).
• 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr plus 2 Wochen jährliche Schließung.
• Deckung durch die umfassende Krankenversicherung des CERN (für Sie, Ihren Ehepartner und Ihre Kinder) und die Mitgliedschaft in der CERN-Pensionskasse.
• Familien-, Kinder- und Säuglingszulagen, abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.
• Ein Umzugspaket (Installationszuschuss und Reisekosten), abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.
• Möglichkeit, Ihren Vertrag bis zu 36 Monate zu verlängern.
• On-the-job und formale Ausbildung einschließlich Sprachunterricht. Überblick über CERN - Entdecken Sie eine Welt, in der das Unmögliche möglich gemacht wird! Unsere bahnbrechende Arbeit bringt nicht nur Physiker zusammen, sondern auch eine Vielzahl von Fachleuten aus den Bereichen Ingenieurwesen, Technik, Wissenschaft und Verwaltung. Gemeinsam fördern wir ein Umfeld, in dem Innovation und Zusammenarbeit gedeihen. Jeden Tag stehen wir vor spannenden neuen Herausforderungen und Möglichkeiten, einen Beitrag zur Spitzenforschung zu leisten, die unser Verständnis des Universums prägt. Wir begegnen diesen Herausforderungen durch die vielfältigen Perspektiven in unseren Teams, stellen sicher, dass jeder Beitrag wertgeschätzt wird und fördern unser gemeinsames Gefühl von Inklusion und Zweck. Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein zentraler Wert des CERN und bleibt für unsere Mission und unseren anhaltenden Erfolg von zentraler Bedeutung. Wenn Sie bereit sind, Teil einer dynamischen, integrativen Gemeinschaft zu sein, die die Grenzen des Wissens überschreitet, ist CERN der Ort, an dem Ihre Neugier und Ihre Fähigkeiten gedeihen können. Seien Sie Teil unserer Mission, das aufzudecken, was im Herzen des Universums liegt! TEIL! Mehr Informationen über uns, hier: careers.cern
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Dans ce rôle, vous contribuerez à un important programme de mise à niveau du complexe d'accélérateur du CERN en maintenant, en remplaçant et en installant des systèmes d'instrumentation de faisceaux. Votre travail quotidien consiste à enlever et installer des composants d'équipement dans les installations d'accélérateur, à suivre les interventions à l'aide des outils de gestion du CERN et à coordonner les progrès sur place avec les ingénieurs et les techniciens. Vos responsabilités
• Enlever les composants d'équipement pour la rénovation ou le remplacement.
• Installez de nouveaux systèmes d'instrumentation et des mises à niveau dans tout le complexe d'accélérateur.
• Suivre vos tâches à l'aide des outils de gestion du CERN et fournir des mises à jour lors des réunions d'équipe.
• Coordonner avec les ingénieurs, les techniciens et d'autres groupes pour tenir chacun informé des progrès sur place.
• Travailler dans différents domaines des installations d'accélérateur du CERN, en suivant tous les protocoles de sécurité et en assurant l'exécution précise et propre des interventions techniques. Votre profil
• Confortable grâce aux outils à main standard et aux équipements techniques de base.
• Aucune expérience préalable n'est requise pour les accélérateurs de particules ou les instruments de faisceaux. Nous vous formerons sur des systèmes spécifiques au CERN. Compétences
• Apprentissage rapide à l'aise s'adaptant aux nouveaux outils, procédures et environnements techniques.
• Attention aux détails et à l'approche prudente lorsque vous travaillez avec des équipements électroniques et électromécaniques sensibles.
• Bon communicateur qui travaille bien avec diverses équipes techniques.
• L'état d'esprit de résolution de problèmes pratiques.
• Anglais parlé et écrit, avec un engagement à apprendre le français. Critères d'éligibilité:
• Vous êtes ressortissant d'un État membre ou associé du CERN .
• À la date limite d'inscription, vous disposez d'un maximum de deux ans d'expérience professionnelle depuis votre diplôme en mécanique ou électrique (ou dans un domaine connexe) et votre diplôme d'études supérieures est un diplôme d'enseignement secondaire général.
• Vous n'avez jamais eu de CERN ni de contrat d'études supérieures.
• Les candidats titulaires d'un baccalauréat, d'une maîtrise ou d'un doctorat ne sont pas admissibles. Date de clôture de l'emploi: 02.08.2026 à 23:59 CEST. Durée du contrat : 24 mois, avec possibilité de prolongation jusqu'à 36 mois maximum. Heures de travail: 40 heures par semaine Flexibilité de l'emploi: Entièrement sur place Date de début prévue : 1er décembre 2026 Cette position implique:
• Travail dans les zones de rayonnement.
• Interventions dans des installations souterraines.
• Un permis de conduire valide.
• Travaillez pendant les nuits, les dimanches et les jours fériés, lorsque les besoins de l ' Organisation l ' exigent. Référence de l'emploi: SY-BI-BL-2026-176-GRAE Domaine de travail: génie électrique ou électronique Travail de référence : 300060 - Technicien en électronique Avantages globaux
• Une allocation mensuelle de 4687 francs suisses par mois (hors taxes).
• 30 jours de congé payé par an plus 2 semaines de fermeture annuelle.
• Couverture par le régime général d'assurance maladie du CERN (pour vous-même, votre conjoint et vos enfants) et affiliation à la Caisse de retraite du CERN.
• Allocations mensuelles pour la famille, l'enfant et l'enfant selon votre situation personnelle.
• Une trousse de réinstallation (subvention d'installation et frais de déplacement) selon votre situation personnelle.
• Possibilité de prolonger votre contrat jusqu'à 36 mois.
• Formation en cours d'emploi et formation formelle, y compris cours de langues. Aperçu du CERN - Découvrez un monde où l'impossible est rendu possible ! Notre travail novateur rassemble non seulement des physiciens, mais aussi des professionnels de l'ingénierie, de la technique, de la science et de l'administration. Ensemble, nous favorisons un environnement où l'innovation et la collaboration prospèrent. Chaque jour, nous faisons face à de nouveaux défis passionnants et à de nouvelles occasions de contribuer à la recherche de pointe qui façonne notre compréhension de l'univers. Nous relevons ces défis grâce aux diverses perspectives au sein de nos équipes, en veillant à ce que chaque contribution soit valorisée et à ce que notre sens commun de l'inclusion et de l'objectif soit déterminé. La diversité est une valeur fondamentale du CERN depuis sa fondation, et elle demeure au cœur de notre mission et de notre succès continu. jobs.description:
Job Overview:
 You will carry out post-doctoral research activities in the field of applied physics and engineering within CERN’s Experimental Physics (EP) Department. You will contribute to the design, development, deployment and operation of physics experiments or experimental setups, with activities spanning detector technologies, material science, mechanical engineering, electronics and computing.

You will work on advanced experimental projects in a highly collaborative and international environment, contributing to large-scale research infrastructures and experimental programmes.

You are applying to a fellowship programme rather than to a specific job; the information provided in your application will be used to identify suitable projects, which will be discussed and refined together with you if your profile is retained.
 Key Tasks:

• You conduct post-doctoral research activities in applied physics and engineering within CERN’s Experimental Physics (EP) Department.

• You contribute to the design, development, deployment and operation of physics experiments or experimental setups.

• You collaborate with physicists, engineers and technical experts on large-scale experimental projects involving advanced technologies.

• You contribute to the analysis, documentation and dissemination of results within the experimental collaborations.
 Candidate Profile:

• You have a strong background in applied physics, engineering or a closely related field.

• You have research experience in applied physics and engineering, ideally linked to the design, development or operation of experimental systems.

• You are interested in pursuing a career in research or academia and in taking an active role within a research project.

• You are motivated to contribute to large-scale experimental programmes in an international research environment.
 Technical Skills:

• You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills applied to experimental systems and technologies.

• You are able to work collaboratively within large, international and multidisciplinary teams.

• You communicate effectively in a scientific and technical environment.

• You are able to work independently while contributing to shared project objectives.

• Your PhD is in the fields of Applied Physics and Engineering.

• Application Deadline: 30/08/2026 at 23:59 (Geneva Time)

• Ideal Stat date: 01.01.2027

• Contract duration: 24 month contract, with a possible extension up to 36 months.

• Weekly Working Hours: 40

• Job flexibility: Fully Onsite

• Location: Geneva, Switzerland

• Job Reference: EP-2026-2/Cat2

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 7004-7425 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
 Be sure to meet the eligibility criteria

• You are a national of a  CERN Member State or Associate Member State . A few exceptions are possible annually.

• By the application deadline, you have a PhD (or will obtain it within six months), and no more than 3 years’ research experience after completion of your PhD degree. Candidates with experience up to 6 years may exceptionally be considered.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• You have a good knowledge of English or French.

• Please pay attention to the additional criteria and requirements for this specific position and mentioned above.

• Please ensure that your application is submitted under the field of work indicated in the position title, as Experimental Physics, Applied Science and Engineering and Theoretical Physics are separate recruitment processes. All open positions within the programme are available on the  Research Fellowship Programme page .
 You will need these documents to complete your application

• Your CV (English or French)

• A copy of your most relevant diploma or a certificate of achievement from your school (if you don't yet have your paper diploma)

• Three recent letters of recommendation (not older than one year at the application deadline) outlining your academic and/or professional achievements, indicating the professional relationship from the referee to you. After submitting your application, you will receive a submission link to forward to your referees; letters must be uploaded confidentially before the closing date (uploading letters yourself is possible but discouraged).

Panoramica del lavoro: Potrai svolgere attività di ricerca post-dottorale nel campo della fisica applicata e dell'ingegneria all'interno del dipartimento di fisica sperimentale del CERN (EP). Contribuirai alla progettazione, allo sviluppo, alla distribuzione e al funzionamento di esperimenti fisici o configurazioni sperimentali, con attività che spaziano dalle tecnologie dei rivelatori, dalla scienza dei materiali, dall'ingegneria meccanica, dall'elettronica e dall'informatica. Si lavorerà su progetti sperimentali avanzati in un ambiente altamente collaborativo e internazionale, contribuendo a infrastrutture di ricerca su larga scala e programmi sperimentali. Si sta applicando a un programma di borsa di studio piuttosto che a un lavoro specifico; le informazioni fornite nella vostra applicazione saranno utilizzate per identificare i progetti adatti, che saranno discussi e raffinati insieme a voi se il vostro profilo è mantenuto. Compiti chiave:
• Conduci attività di ricerca post-dottorale in fisica applicata e ingegneria all’interno del Dipartimento di Fisica Sperimentale del CERN (EP).
• Contribuisci alla progettazione, allo sviluppo, alla distribuzione e al funzionamento di esperimenti fisici o alle configurazioni sperimentali.
• Collaborate con fisici, ingegneri ed esperti tecnici su progetti sperimentali su larga scala che coinvolgono tecnologie avanzate.
• Contribuisci all'analisi, alla documentazione e alla diffusione dei risultati nelle collaborazioni sperimentali. Profilo del candidato:
• Hai un forte background in fisica applicata, ingegneria o un campo strettamente correlato.
• Hai esperienza di ricerca in fisica applicata e ingegneria, idealmente legata alla progettazione, sviluppo o funzionamento di sistemi sperimentali.
• Sei interessato a perseguire una carriera nella ricerca o nell'accademia e ad assumere un ruolo attivo all'interno di un progetto di ricerca.
• Sei motivato a contribuire a programmi sperimentali su larga scala in un ambiente di ricerca internazionale. Competenze tecniche:
• Hai forti capacità analitiche e di problem solving applicate a sistemi e tecnologie sperimentali.
• Sei in grado di lavorare in collaborazione all'interno di team di grandi, internazionali e multidisciplinari.
• Si comunica efficacemente in un ambiente scientifico e tecnico.
• Siete in grado di lavorare in modo indipendente, contribuendo a obiettivi di progetto condivisi.
• Il vostro dottorato è nei campi della fisica applicata e dell'ingegneria.
• Scadenza dell'applicazione: 30/08/2026 a 23:59 (Ginevra Tempo)
• Data ideale: 01.01.2027
• Durata del contratto: contratto di 24 mesi, con una possibile proroga fino a 36 mesi.
• Ore lavorative settimanali: 40
• Flessibilità del lavoro: Fully Onsite
• Ubicazione: Ginevra, Svizzera
• Riferimento del lavoro: EP-2026-2/Cat2 Vantaggi globali
• Una spesa mensile tra 7004-7425 Franco Svizzero al mese (gratuito dalla tassa) a seconda della laurea.
• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.
• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.
• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.
• Un pacchetto di trasferimento (concessione di installazione e spese di viaggio) a seconda delle vostre circostanze individuali.
• Possibilità di estendere il contratto fino a 36 mesi.
• On-the-job e formazione formale, comprese le lezioni di lingua. Assicurarsi di soddisfare i criteri di ammissibilità
• Sei un cittadino di uno Stato membro del CERN o di uno Stato membro associato . Alcune eccezioni sono possibili annualmente.
• Con la scadenza della domanda, si dispone di un PhD (o lo otterrà entro sei mesi), e non più di 3 anni di esperienza di ricerca dopo il completamento del dottorato di ricerca. I candidati con esperienza fino a 6 anni possono essere considerati eccezionalmente.
• Non hai mai avuto un contratto di laurea o di socio del CERN.
• Hai una buona conoscenza di inglese o francese.
• Si prega di prestare attenzione ai criteri e ai requisiti aggiuntivi per questa specifica posizione e menzionato sopra.
• Si prega di assicurarsi che la vostra domanda sia presentata sotto il campo di lavoro indicato nel titolo di posizione, come fisica sperimentale, scienza applicata e ingegneria e fisica teorica sono processi di reclutamento separati. Tutte le posizioni aperte all'interno del programma sono disponibili nella pagina del programma di ricerca Fellowship . Avrete bisogno di questi documenti per completare la vostra applicazione
• Il tuo CV (inglese o francese)
• Una copia del vostro diploma più rilevante o un certificato di successo dalla vostra scuola (se non avete ancora il diploma di carta)
• Tre recenti lettere di raccomandazione (non più di un anno al termine della domanda) che delineano i vostri risultati accademici e/o professionali, indicando il rapporto professionale dall'arbitro a voi. Dopo aver presentato la tua domanda, riceverai un link di presentazione per inoltrare i tuoi arbitri; le lettere devono essere caricate confidenziali prima della data di chiusura (il caricamento delle lettere è possibile ma scoraggiato). Panoramica del CERN - Scopri un mondo in cui l'impossibile è reso possibile! Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano. Ogni giorno affrontiamo nuove entusiasmanti sfide e opportunità per contribuire alla ricerca all'avanguardia che plasma la nostra comprensione dell'universo. Incontriamo queste sfide attraverso le diverse prospettive all'interno dei nostri team, assicurando che ogni contributo sia valutato e guida il nostro senso condiviso di inclusione e scopo. La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione, e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e il successo continuo. Se siete pronti a far parte di una comunità dinamica e inclusiva che spinge i confini della conoscenza, il CERN è il luogo in cui la vostra curiosità e abilità possono prosperare. Fate parte della nostra missione per scoprire cosa sta nel cuore dell'universo! Partita! Ulteriori informazioni su di noi, qui
descriptionByLocale.en:
Job Overview:
You will carry out post-doctoral research activities in the field of applied physics and engineering within CERN’s Experimental Physics (EP) Department. You will contribute to the design, development, deployment and operation of physics experiments or experimental setups, with activities spanning detector technologies, material science, mechanical engineering, electronics and computing.

You will work on advanced experimental projects in a highly collaborative and international environment, contributing to large-scale research infrastructures and experimental programmes.

You are applying to a fellowship programme rather than to a specific job; the information provided in your application will be used to identify suitable projects, which will be discussed and refined together with you if your profile is retained.
Key Tasks:

• You conduct post-doctoral research activities in applied physics and engineering within CERN’s Experimental Physics (EP) Department.

• You contribute to the design, development, deployment and operation of physics experiments or experimental setups.

• You collaborate with physicists, engineers and technical experts on large-scale experimental projects involving advanced technologies.

• You contribute to the analysis, documentation and dissemination of results within the experimental collaborations.
Candidate Profile:

• You have a strong background in applied physics, engineering or a closely related field.

• You have research experience in applied physics and engineering, ideally linked to the design, development or operation of experimental systems.

• You are interested in pursuing a career in research or academia and in taking an active role within a research project.

• You are motivated to contribute to large-scale experimental programmes in an international research environment.
Technical Skills:

• You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills applied to experimental systems and technologies.

• You are able to work collaboratively within large, international and multidisciplinary teams.

• You communicate effectively in a scientific and technical environment.

• You are able to work independently while contributing to shared project objectives.

• Your PhD is in the fields of Applied Physics and Engineering.

• Application Deadline: 30/08/2026 at 23:59 (Geneva Time)

• Ideal Stat date: 01.01.2027

• Contract duration: 24 month contract, with a possible extension up to 36 months.

• Weekly Working Hours: 40

• Job flexibility: Fully Onsite

• Location: Geneva, Switzerland

• Job Reference: EP-2026-2/Cat2

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 7004-7425 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
Be sure to meet the eligibility criteria

• You are a national of a  CERN Member State or Associate Member State . A few exceptions are possible annually.

• By the application deadline, you have a PhD (or will obtain it within six months), and no more than 3 years’ research experience after completion of your PhD degree. Candidates with experience up to 6 years may exceptionally be considered.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• You have a good knowledge of English or French.

• Please pay attention to the additional criteria and requirements for this specific position and mentioned above.

• Please ensure that your application is submitted under the field of work indicated in the position title, as Experimental Physics, Applied Science and Engineering and Theoretical Physics are separate recruitment processes. All open positions within the programme are available on the  Research Fellowship Programme page .
You will need these documents to complete your application

• Your CV (English or French)

• A copy of your most relevant diploma or a certificate of achievement from your school (if you don't yet have your paper diploma)

• Three recent letters of recommendation (not older than one year at the application deadline) outlining your academic and/or professional achievements, indicating the professional relationship from the referee to you. After submitting your application, you will receive a submission link to forward to your referees; letters must be uploaded confidentially before the closing date (uploading letters yourself is possible but discouraged).
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
More information about us, here
descriptionByLocale.de:
Stellenübersicht: Sie werden Post-Doc-Forschungsaktivitäten auf dem Gebiet der angewandten Physik und Ingenieurwissenschaften innerhalb der CERN-Abteilung für Experimentelle Physik (EP) durchführen. Sie werden zum Design, zur Entwicklung, zum Einsatz und zum Betrieb von Physikexperimenten oder experimentellen Setups beitragen, mit Aktivitäten, die Detektortechnologien, Materialwissenschaften, Maschinenbau, Elektronik und Computer umfassen. Sie werden an fortgeschrittenen experimentellen Projekten in einem hochgradig kooperativen und internationalen Umfeld arbeiten und zu großen Forschungsinfrastrukturen und experimentellen Programmen beitragen. Sie bewerben sich für ein Stipendienprogramm und nicht für eine bestimmte Stelle; anhand der in Ihrer Bewerbung angegebenen Informationen werden geeignete Projekte identifiziert, die gemeinsam mit Ihnen diskutiert und verfeinert werden, wenn Ihr Profil erhalten bleibt. Hauptaufgaben:
• Sie führen Post-Doc-Forschungsaktivitäten in angewandter Physik und Ingenieurwissenschaften in der Abteilung Experimentelle Physik (EP) des CERN durch.
• Sie tragen zur Gestaltung, Entwicklung, Bereitstellung und zum Betrieb von physikalischen Experimenten oder experimentellen Setups bei.
• Sie arbeiten mit Physikern, Ingenieuren und technischen Experten an groß angelegten experimentellen Projekten mit fortschrittlichen Technologien zusammen.
• Sie tragen zur Analyse, Dokumentation und Verbreitung der Ergebnisse im Rahmen der experimentellen Kooperationen bei. Bewerberprofil:
• Sie haben einen starken Hintergrund in angewandter Physik, Ingenieurwesen oder einem eng verwandten Bereich.
• Sie haben Forschungserfahrung in angewandter Physik und Ingenieurwissenschaften, die idealerweise mit dem Entwurf, der Entwicklung oder dem Betrieb von experimentellen Systemen verbunden sind.
• Sie sind daran interessiert, eine Karriere in der Forschung oder Wissenschaft zu verfolgen und eine aktive Rolle in einem Forschungsprojekt zu übernehmen.
• Sie sind motiviert, zu groß angelegten experimentellen Programmen in einem internationalen Forschungsumfeld beizutragen. Technische Fähigkeiten:
• Sie verfügen über starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten, die auf experimentelle Systeme und Technologien angewendet werden.
• Sie können in großen, internationalen und multidisziplinären Teams zusammenarbeiten.
• Sie kommunizieren effektiv in einem wissenschaftlichen und technischen Umfeld.
• Sie können unabhängig arbeiten und gleichzeitig zu gemeinsamen Projektzielen beitragen.
• Ihre PhD ist in den Bereichen Angewandte Physik und Ingenieurwissenschaften.
• Bewerbungsschluss: 30/08/2026 um 23:59 Uhr (Genfer Zeit)
• Ideales Stat-Datum: 01.01.2027
• Vertragsdauer: 24-Monats-Vertrag, mit einer möglichen Verlängerung auf bis zu 36 Monate.
• Wöchentliche Arbeitszeit: 40
• Arbeitsplatzflexibilität: Vollständig vor Ort
• Standort: Genf, Schweiz
• Stellenbeschreibung: EP-2026-2/Cat2 Globale Vorteile
• Ein monatliches Stipendium zwischen 7004-7425 Schweizer Franken pro Monat (steuerfrei), abhängig von Ihrem Abschluss.
• 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr plus 2 Wochen jährliche Schließung.
• Deckung durch die umfassende Krankenversicherung des CERN (für Sie, Ihren Ehepartner und Ihre Kinder) und die Mitgliedschaft in der CERN-Pensionskasse.
• Familien-, Kinder- und Säuglingszulagen, abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.
• Ein Umzugspaket (Installationszuschuss und Reisekosten), abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.
• Möglichkeit, Ihren Vertrag bis zu 36 Monate zu verlängern.
• On-the-job und formale Ausbildung einschließlich Sprachunterricht. Achten Sie darauf, die Förderkriterien zu erfüllen
• Sie sind Staatsangehöriger eines CERN-Mitgliedstaats oder assoziierten Mitgliedstaats. Einige Ausnahmen sind jährlich möglich.
• Bis zum Bewerbungsschluss haben Sie einen PhD (oder erhalten ihn innerhalb von sechs Monaten) und nicht mehr als 3 Jahre Forschungserfahrung nach Abschluss Ihres PhD-Abschlusses. Kandidaten mit Erfahrung bis zu 6 Jahren können ausnahmsweise in Betracht gezogen werden.
• Sie hatten noch nie einen CERN-Stipendiaten- oder Absolventenvertrag.
• Sie haben gute Englisch- oder Französischkenntnisse.
• Bitte beachten Sie die zusätzlichen Kriterien und Anforderungen für diese spezifische Position und oben erwähnt.
• Bitte stellen Sie sicher, dass Ihre Bewerbung unter dem in der Positionsbezeichnung angegebenen Arbeitsbereich eingereicht wird, da Experimentalphysik, Angewandte Technik und Theoretische Physik separate Rekrutierungsprozesse sind. Alle offenen Stellen innerhalb des Programms sind auf der Seite des Forschungsstipendiums verfügbar. Sie benötigen diese Dokumente, um Ihre Bewerbung abzuschließen
• Ihr Lebenslauf (Englisch oder Französisch)
• Eine Kopie Ihres wichtigsten Diploms oder eine Leistungsbescheinigung Ihrer Schule (wenn Sie noch kein Papierdiplom haben)
• Drei aktuelle Empfehlungsschreiben (nicht älter als ein Jahr zum Bewerbungsschluss), in denen Ihre akademischen und / oder beruflichen Leistungen dargelegt werden und die berufliche Beziehung des Schiedsrichters zu Ihnen angegeben wird. Nachdem Sie Ihre Bewerbung eingereicht haben, erhalten Sie einen Einreichungslink zur Weiterleitung an Ihre Schiedsrichter; Briefe müssen vor dem Abschlussdatum vertraulich hochgeladen werden (das Hochladen von Briefen selbst ist möglich, aber entmutigt). Überblick über CERN - Entdecken Sie eine Welt, in der das Unmögliche möglich gemacht wird! Bei CERN, der Europäischen Organisation für Kernforschung, erweitern wir die Grenzen von Wissenschaft und Technologie. Unsere bahnbrechende Arbeit bringt nicht nur Physiker zusammen, sondern auch eine Vielzahl von Fachleuten aus den Bereichen Ingenieurwesen, Technik, Wissenschaft und Verwaltung. Gemeinsam fördern wir ein Umfeld, in dem Innovation und Zusammenarbeit gedeihen. Jeden Tag stehen wir vor spannenden neuen Herausforderungen und Möglichkeiten, einen Beitrag zur Spitzenforschung zu leisten, die unser Verständnis des Universums prägt. Wir begegnen diesen Herausforderungen durch die vielfältigen Perspektiven in unseren Teams, stellen sicher, dass jeder Beitrag wertgeschätzt wird und fördern unser gemeinsames Gefühl von Inklusion und Zweck. Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein zentraler Wert des CERN und bleibt für unsere Mission und unseren anhaltenden Erfolg von zentraler Bedeutung. Wenn Sie bereit sind, Teil einer dynamischen, integrativen Gemeinschaft zu sein, die die Grenzen des Wissens überschreitet, ist CERN der Ort, an dem Ihre Neugier und Ihre Fähigkeiten gedeihen können. Seien Sie Teil unserer Mission, das aufzudecken, was im Herzen des Universums liegt! TEIL! Mehr Informationen über uns, hier
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Aperçu de l'emploi : Vous effectuerez des activités de recherche postdoctorale dans le domaine de la physique appliquée et du génie au sein du département de physique expérimentale du CERN. Vous contribuerez à la conception, au développement, au déploiement et au fonctionnement d'expériences de physique ou de configurations expérimentales, avec des activités couvrant les technologies de détecteur, la science des matériaux, l'ingénierie mécanique, l'électronique et l'informatique. Vous travaillerez sur des projets expérimentaux avancés dans un environnement hautement collaboratif et international, contribuant à des infrastructures de recherche à grande échelle et des programmes expérimentaux. Vous postulez à un programme de bourses plutôt qu'à un emploi spécifique; les informations fournies dans votre demande seront utilisées pour identifier les projets appropriés, qui seront discutés et affinés avec vous si votre profil est conservé. Principales tâches :
• Vous effectuez des activités de recherche postdoctorale en physique appliquée et en génie au sein du département de physique expérimentale du CERN.
• Vous contribuez à la conception, au développement, au déploiement et au fonctionnement d'expériences physiques ou de configurations expérimentales.
• Vous collaborez avec des physiciens, des ingénieurs et des experts techniques sur des projets expérimentaux à grande échelle impliquant des technologies avancées.
• Vous contribuez à l'analyse, la documentation et la diffusion des résultats au sein des collaborations expérimentales. Profil du candidat :
• Vous avez une solide expérience en physique appliquée, en ingénierie ou dans un domaine étroitement lié.
• Vous avez une expérience de recherche en physique appliquée et en ingénierie, idéalement liée à la conception, au développement ou au fonctionnement de systèmes expérimentaux.
• Vous êtes intéressé à poursuivre une carrière en recherche ou en milieu universitaire et à jouer un rôle actif dans un projet de recherche.
• Vous êtes motivé à contribuer à des programmes expérimentaux à grande échelle dans un environnement de recherche international. Compétences techniques :
• Vous avez de solides compétences analytiques et de résolution de problèmes appliquées aux systèmes et technologies expérimentaux.
• Vous pouvez travailler en collaboration au sein de grandes équipes internationales et multidisciplinaires.
• Vous communiquez efficacement dans un environnement scientifique et technique.
• Vous êtes en mesure de travailler de façon indépendante tout en contribuant aux objectifs communs du projet.
• Votre doctorat est dans les domaines de la physique appliquée et de l'ingénierie.
• Date limite de dépôt des candidatures: 30/08/2026 à 23:59 (heure de Genève)
• Date idéale de Stat: 01.01.2027
• Durée du contrat : contrat de 24 mois, avec une prolongation possible de 36 mois.
• Heures de travail hebdomadaires: 40
• Flexibilité de l'emploi: Entièrement sur place
• Lieu: Genève, Suisse
• Référence emploi: EP-2026-2/Cat2 Avantages globaux
• Une allocation mensuelle entre 7004-7425 Francs suisses par mois (sans impôt) selon votre diplôme.
• 30 jours de congé payé par an plus 2 semaines de fermeture annuelle.
• Couverture par le régime général d'assurance maladie du CERN (pour vous-même, votre conjoint et vos enfants) et affiliation à la Caisse de retraite du CERN.
• Allocations mensuelles pour la famille, l'enfant et l'enfant selon votre situation personnelle.
• Une trousse de réinstallation (subvention d'installation et frais de déplacement) selon votre situation personnelle.
• Possibilité de prolonger votre contrat jusqu'à 36 mois.
• Formation en cours d'emploi et formation formelle, y compris cours de langues. Assurez-vous de satisfaire aux critères d'admissibilité
• Vous êtes ressortissant d'un État membre du CERN ou d'un État membre associé . Quelques exceptions sont possibles chaque année.
• D'ici la date limite, vous avez un doctorat (ou l'obtiendrez dans les six mois) et pas plus de 3 ans d'expérience de recherche après avoir terminé votre doctorat. Les candidats ayant jusqu'à 6 ans d'expérience peuvent exceptionnellement être considérés.
• Vous n'avez jamais eu de CERN ni de contrat d'études supérieures.
• Vous avez une bonne connaissance de l'anglais ou du français.
• Veuillez prêter attention aux critères et exigences supplémentaires pour ce poste spécifique et mentionnés ci-dessus.
• Veuillez vous assurer que votre demande est soumise dans le domaine de travail indiqué dans le titre du poste, puisque la physique expérimentale, la science appliquée et l'ingénierie et la physique théorique sont des processus de recrutement distincts. Tous les postes vacants du programme sont disponibles sur la page Programme de bourses de recherche . Vous aurez besoin de ces documents pour compléter votre demande
• Votre CV (anglais ou français)
• Une copie de votre diplôme le plus pertinent ou un certificat de réussite de votre école (si vous n'avez pas encore votre diplôme en papier)
• Trois récentes lettres de recommandation (pas plus d'un an à la date limite de présentation des demandes) décrivant vos réalisations scolaires et/ou professionnelles, indiquant la relation professionnelle entre le répondant et vous. Après avoir soumis votre demande, vous recevrez un lien de soumission à transmettre à vos répondants; les lettres doivent être téléchargées de façon confidentielle avant la date de clôture (le téléchargement des lettres vous-même est possible mais découragé). Aperçu du CERN - Découvrez un monde où l'impossible est rendu possible ! Au CERN, l'Organisation européenne pour la recherche nucléaire, nous repoussons les frontières de la science et de la technologie. Notre travail novateur rassemble non seulement des physiciens, mais aussi des professionnels de l'ingénierie, de la technique, de la science et de l'administration. Ensemble, nous favorisons un environnement où l'innovation et la collaboration prospèrent. Chaque jour, nous faisons face à de nouveaux défis passionnants et à de nouvelles occasions de contribuer à la recherche de pointe qui façonne notre compréhension de l'univers. Nous relevons ces défis grâce aux diverses perspectives au sein de nos équipes, en veillant à ce que chaque contribution soit valorisée et à ce que notre sens commun de l'inclusion et de l'objectif soit déterminé. La diversité est une valeur fondamentale du CERN depuis sa fondation, et elle demeure au cœur de notre mission et de notre succès continu. Si vous êtes prêt à faire partie d'une communauté dynamique et inclusive qui repousse les limites du savoir, le CERN est l'endroit où votre curiosité et vos compétences peuvent prospérer. Faites partie de notre mission de découvrir ce qui est au cœur de l'univers ! S'il vous plaît ! Plus d'informations sur nous, ici

jobs.title: Mechanical Technician (SY-STI-BDE-2026-181-GRAE)
jobs.description:
The SY-STI-BDE Section oversees the conceptual design, construction, operation, and maintenance of beam-intercepting devices across the CERN's accelerator complex. The beam intercepting devices are precision mechanical equipment working in harsh environments that must be very reliable to guarantee the operation of CERN accelerators.
 Are you passionate about mechanical engineering and skilled at multitasking? Join us and become part of a multidisciplinary team responsible for the design, assembly, installation, and maintenance of beam-intercepting devices. You will support safety-critical systems and an efficient operation of CERN's accelerators.
 Your responsibilities

• Participate in the purchase, storage and shipment of raw material and components.

• Handle the conditioning of several components to be compliant with the Ultra-High Vacuum (UHV) requirements of collimators.

• Perform the machining of simple parts based on drawings produced with CAD programs.

• Be active on the assembly of collimators and several sub-components and its auxiliary systems.

• Participate in the assembly of the HL-LHC beam dump systems.

• Keep track and maintain all related documents and databases.

• Take an active role in the installation, commissioning and maintenance of the equipment.

• Manage the appropriate disposal/storage of radioactive parts and equipment withdrawn from the facility.

• Provide mechanical and logistics support.

• Contribute to mechanical support activities around different facilities at CERN.
 Your profile

• Assembling and testing precision mechanics.

• Knowledge in designing mechanical components.
 Skills

• Knowledge of CAD systems, 3D and 2D drawing.

• Good communication.

• Well-organised.

• Accountability.

• Working in a team, as well as independently

jobs.description:
As an experienced Data Analyst with a solid background in physics, you will join the team responsible for the LHC Longitudinal Density Monitor (commonly known as the BSRL: Beam Synchrotron Radiation Longitudinal monitor) within the Beam Instrumentation Group.
 In this role, you will lead the work on the online and offline data processing pipelines, which are fully implemented in Python. The analysis results from this instrument are mission-critical, directly impacting the calibration of the LHC experiments, facilitating the troubleshooting of operational issues, and enabling detailed beam physics analysis.
 Additionally, you will play an important role in R&D and optimisation, conducting advanced studies to shape the upcoming upgrades of the BSRL instrument.
 Your responsibilities

• Lead the redesign and optimisation of the current online and offline Python data analysis software for the BSRL instrument to ensure scalability, performance and reproducibility.

• Develop specialised offline analysis routines using BSRL data, cross-correlating with other beam instrumentation where necessary, to meet the requirements of stakeholders.

• Extend the online and offline diagnostics tools, architecting automated notification systems to detect early signs of instrument degradation, anomalies, or malfunctions.

• Design and implement the specific software tools, calibration routines, and data pipelines required for the rapid commissioning of the renovated system after the Long Shutdown 3 (LS3).

• Contribute to the validation and performance verification of the associated upgraded hardware planned for deployment during LS3.

• Evaluate and benchmark different upgrade scenarios for LS3 by combining advanced data analysis of historical run data with physics-based simulation techniques.
 Your profile

• Proven background in the advanced analysis of complex experimental data, preferably from physics or large-scale scientific installations.

• Extensive experience in software development with a strong emphasis on clean, maintainable code.

• Basic experience in Monte Carlo-based physics simulation techniques.

• Basic experience with laboratory work.
 Skills

• In-depth knowledge of advanced statistical methods, data modelling, and data analysis techniques applied to scientific datasets.

• Proven proficiency in Python, including familiarity with the standard scientific stack (such as NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, etc) for high-performance processing.

• Knowledge of version control systems (Git/Gilab) and continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD)

• Basic knowledge of photon counting techniques would be advantage.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Applied Physics, Data Analytics (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

descriptionByLocale.en:
As an experienced Data Analyst with a solid background in physics, you will join the team responsible for the LHC Longitudinal Density Monitor (commonly known as the BSRL: Beam Synchrotron Radiation Longitudinal monitor) within the Beam Instrumentation Group.
In this role, you will lead the work on the online and offline data processing pipelines, which are fully implemented in Python. The analysis results from this instrument are mission-critical, directly impacting the calibration of the LHC experiments, facilitating the troubleshooting of operational issues, and enabling detailed beam physics analysis.
Additionally, you will play an important role in R&D and optimisation, conducting advanced studies to shape the upcoming upgrades of the BSRL instrument.
Your responsibilities

• Lead the redesign and optimisation of the current online and offline Python data analysis software for the BSRL instrument to ensure scalability, performance and reproducibility.

• Develop specialised offline analysis routines using BSRL data, cross-correlating with other beam instrumentation where necessary, to meet the requirements of stakeholders.

• Extend the online and offline diagnostics tools, architecting automated notification systems to detect early signs of instrument degradation, anomalies, or malfunctions.

• Design and implement the specific software tools, calibration routines, and data pipelines required for the rapid commissioning of the renovated system after the Long Shutdown 3 (LS3).

• Contribute to the validation and performance verification of the associated upgraded hardware planned for deployment during LS3.

• Evaluate and benchmark different upgrade scenarios for LS3 by combining advanced data analysis of historical run data with physics-based simulation techniques.
Your profile

• Proven background in the advanced analysis of complex experimental data, preferably from physics or large-scale scientific installations.

• Extensive experience in software development with a strong emphasis on clean, maintainable code.

• Basic experience in Monte Carlo-based physics simulation techniques.

• Basic experience with laboratory work.
Skills

• In-depth knowledge of advanced statistical methods, data modelling, and data analysis techniques applied to scientific datasets.

• Proven proficiency in Python, including familiarity with the standard scientific stack (such as NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, etc) for high-performance processing.

• Knowledge of version control systems (Git/Gilab) and continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD)

• Basic knowledge of photon counting techniques would be advantage.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Applied Physics, Data Analytics (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 24.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Hybrid

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
Job reference: SY-BI-SW-2026-127-GRAP
Field of work: Data Science & Data Analytics
Benchmark job: 200140 - Applied Physicist
