At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!

descriptionByLocale.de:
CERN entwirft, entwickelt und betreibt Teilchenbeschleuniger und Experimente für die wissenschaftliche Forschung, um die grundlegenden Gesetze des Universums zu verstehen. Diese Aktivitäten können aufgrund der Wechselwirkung zwischen Strahlen und Materie Streustrahlung erzeugen. Die in der Nähe der verschiedenen Strahlenlinien und Ziele installierten Strahlungsdetektoren ermöglichen es dem CERN, die Strahlungspegel genau zu überwachen. Innerhalb der HSE-TS-IMS-Sektion am CERN ist das Team für das Design und die Entwicklung dieser Spezialausrüstung sowie für die Installation, Inbetriebnahme, den Betrieb und die Wartung verantwortlich.
Die Strahlungsüberwachung ist unerlässlich, um das CERN in die Lage zu versetzen, seinen Beschleunigerkomplex und damit verbundene Experimente durchzuführen und gleichzeitig seinen gesetzlichen Verpflichtungen zum Schutz der Öffentlichkeit, der am CERN-Standort arbeitenden Menschen und der Umwelt nachzukommen. In diesem strengen Kontext entwickelt die TS-IMS-Sektion eine neue Generation von ASICs, um Ionisationskammersignale mit sicherheitskritischen Überwachungssystemen zu verbinden und anspruchsvolle Leistungs- und Zuverlässigkeitsanforderungen zu erfüllen.
Ihre Verantwortung
Sie werden unter einem Team von Ingenieuren und Technikern arbeiten, um:

• Design, Simulation und Verifizierung der digitalen Architektur des ASIC-Frontends der nächsten Generation.

• Bereiten Sie RTL-Designs für Tapeout mit Open-Source-EDA-Flows vor, einschließlich Bodenplanung und physischer Designvorbereitung.

• Unterstützung der Einführung nach der Fertigung, der Systemcharakterisierung und der Funktions-/Leistungsvalidierung.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Analog-, Verifizierungs- und SoC-Integrationsteams, um eine nahtlose Systemkompatibilität zu gewährleisten.

• Praktische Erfahrungen mit Open-Source-ASIC-EDA-Flows (Yosys, OpenROAD, LibreLane usw.) von RTL zu GDSII.

• Erfahrung mit Bodenplanung, Einschränkungsdefinition und physischer Designvorbereitung für Tapeout.

• Post-Tapeout Prototyp Bring-up und Hardware-Debugging-Erfahrung ist vorteilhaft.

• Aktive Beiträge zu Open-Source-Hardwareprojekten oder EDA-Toolchains sind vorteilhaft.

• Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von SoC-Submodulen ist vorteilhaft.
Fähigkeiten

• HDL-Design und Simulation in VHDL, Verilog oder SystemVerilog.

• Guter Teamplayer: Zusammenarbeit in analogen, digitalen, Verifizierungs- und SoC-Teams.

• Kenntnisse in Git, CI/CD-Pipelines und automatisierten Verifizierungsworkflows.

• Kenntnisse der RISC-V-Architektur.

• Vertrautheit mit Mixed-Signal-Integration und digitalen Schnittstellenprotokollen.

• Komfort mit Linux-basierten Entwicklungsumgebungen und Skripten für die Automatisierung (Python, Bash usw.).

• Englisch gesprochen und geschrieben, mit der Verpflichtung, Französisch zu lernen.
Förderkriterien:

• Sie sind Staatsangehöriger eines CERN-Mitglieds oder assoziierten Mitgliedstaats.

• Bis zum Bewerbungsschluss haben Sie seit dem Abschluss in Elektronik (oder einem verwandten Bereich) maximal zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung und Ihre höchste Bildungsqualifikation ist entweder ein Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss.

• Sie hatten noch nie einen CERN-Stipendiaten- oder Absolventenvertrag.

• Bewerber ohne Hochschulabschluss sind nicht förderfähig.

• Bewerber mit einem PhD sind nicht förderfähig.

Bei CERN, der Europäischen Organisation für Kernforschung, erweitern wir die Grenzen von Wissenschaft und Technologie. Unsere bahnbrechende Arbeit bringt nicht nur Physiker zusammen, sondern auch eine Vielzahl von Fachleuten aus den Bereichen Ingenieurwesen, Technik, Wissenschaft und Verwaltung. Gemeinsam fördern wir ein Umfeld, in dem Innovation und Zusammenarbeit gedeihen.
Jeden Tag stehen wir vor spannenden neuen Herausforderungen und Möglichkeiten, einen Beitrag zur Spitzenforschung zu leisten, die unser Verständnis des Universums prägt. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le CERN conçoit, développe et exploite des accélérateurs de particules et des expériences de recherche scientifique pour comprendre les lois fondamentales de l'univers. Ces activités peuvent générer des rayonnements parasites en raison de l'interaction entre les faisceaux et la matière. Les détecteurs de rayonnement installés près des différentes lignes et cibles de faisceau permettent au CERN de surveiller avec précision les niveaux de rayonnement. Au sein de la section HSE-TS-IMS du CERN, l'équipe est responsable de la conception et du développement de cet équipement spécialisé, ainsi que de son installation, de sa mise en service, de son fonctionnement et de sa maintenance.
La surveillance des rayonnements est essentielle pour permettre au CERN d'exploiter son complexe d'accélérateurs et ses expériences connexes tout en remplissant ses obligations légales de protection du public, des personnes travaillant sur le site du CERN et de l'environnement. Dans ce contexte rigoureux, la Section TS-IMS développe une nouvelle génération d'ASIC permettant d'interfacer les signaux des chambres d'ionisation avec des systèmes de surveillance critiques en matière de sécurité, répondant aux exigences de performance et de fiabilité difficiles.
Vos responsabilités
Vous travaillerez parmi une équipe d'ingénieurs et de techniciens pour :

• Concevoir, simuler et vérifier l'architecture numérique du front-end ASIC de prochaine génération.

• Préparer des modèles RTL pour la dématérialisation à l'aide de flux EDA à source ouverte, y compris la planification du plancher et la préparation de la conception physique.

• Soutenir l'apport post-fabrication, la caractérisation du système et la validation fonctionnelle/performance.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes d'intégration analogique, de vérification et de SoC pour assurer une compatibilité sans faille au niveau du système.
Votre profil

• Expérience pratique des flux ASIC EDA open source (Yosys, OpenROAD, LibreLane, etc.) de RTL à GDSII.

• Expérience de la planification des planchers, de la définition des contraintes et de la préparation de la conception physique pour le ruban adhésif.

• L'expérience de débogage du prototype post-enregistrement est avantageuse.

• Les contributions actives à des projets matériels open-source ou à des chaînes d'outils EDA sont avantageuses.

• L'expérience du développement des sous-modules SoC est avantageuse.
Compétences

• Conception et simulation HDL en VHDL, Verilog ou SystemVerilog.

• Bon joueur d'équipe : compétences en collaboration entre équipes analogiques, numériques, de vérification et SoC.

• Connaissance des pipelines Git, CI/CD et des processus de vérification automatisés.

• Connaissance de l'architecture RISC-V.

• Familiarité avec intégration mixte et protocoles d'interface numérique.

• Confort avec les environnements de développement basés sur Linux et scripts pour l'automatisation (Python, Bash, etc.).

• Anglais parlé et écrit, avec un engagement à apprendre le français.
Critères d'éligibilité:

• Vous êtes ressortissant d'un État membre ou associé du CERN .

• À la date limite d'inscription, vous disposez d'un maximum de deux ans d'expérience professionnelle depuis votre diplôme en électronique (ou dans un domaine connexe) et votre plus haute qualification est soit un baccalauréat ou une maîtrise.

• Vous n'avez jamais eu de CERN ni de contrat d'études supérieures.

• Les candidats sans diplôme universitaire ne sont pas admissibles.

• Les candidats ayant un doctorat ne sont pas admissibles.

Avantages globaux

• Une allocation mensuelle entre 5266-5793 Francs suisses par mois (sans impôt) selon votre diplôme.

• Couverture par le régime général d'assurance maladie du CERN (pour vous-même, votre conjoint et vos enfants) et affiliation à la Caisse de retraite du CERN.

• Allocations mensuelles pour la famille, l'enfant et l'enfant selon votre situation personnelle.

• Une trousse de réinstallation (subvention d'installation et frais de déplacement) selon votre situation personnelle.

• Possibilité de prolonger votre contrat jusqu'à 36 mois.

• Formation en cours d'emploi et formation formelle, y compris cours de langues.
Aperçu du CERN - Découvrez un monde où l'impossible est rendu possible !
Au CERN, l'Organisation européenne pour la recherche nucléaire, nous repoussons les frontières de la science et de la technologie. Notre travail novateur rassemble non seulement des physiciens, mais aussi des professionnels de l'ingénierie, de la technique, de la science et de l'administration. Ensemble, nous favorisons un environnement où l'innovation et la collaboration prospèrent.
Chaque jour, nous faisons face à de nouveaux défis passionnants et à de nouvelles occasions de contribuer à la recherche de pointe qui façonne notre compréhension de l'univers. Nous relevons ces défis grâce aux diverses perspectives au sein de nos équipes, en veillant à ce que chaque contribution soit valorisée et à ce que notre sens commun de l'inclusion et de l'objectif soit déterminé. La diversité est une valeur fondamentale du CERN depuis sa fondation, et elle demeure au cœur de notre mission et de notre succès continu.
Si vous êtes prêt à faire partie d'une communauté dynamique et inclusive qui repousse les limites du savoir, le CERN est l'endroit où votre curiosité et vos compétences peuvent prospérer. Faites partie de notre mission de découvrir ce qui est au cœur de l'univers ! S'il vous plaît !

jobs.title: Electronics Engineer (HSE-TS-IMS-2026-161-LD)
jobs.description:
Introduction
 Are you a skilled and experienced electronics engineer? Do you want to work in one of the world’s leading scientific Intergovernmental Organisations? Come and join a unique environment whose core value is excellence, and whose defining characteristic is teamwork. CERN, take part!
 You will work in the TS-Group within the  HSE Unit , which is responsible for occupational health and safety, including radiation protection, environmental protection, and emergency preparedness and response. Activities cover the monitoring and reporting of the environmental and radiological impacts of the Organization’s activities.
 In your role as an electronics engineer, you will be involved in the development and improvement of radiation and environmental monitoring solutions. This includes participating in the full lifecycle of hardware and embedded firmware development using modern methodologies and technologies.
 Functions

• Design and develop mixed-signal electronics, with a focus on analogue sensor interfaces and ultra-low-current measurement circuits.

• Develop and maintain embedded code in VHDL and C to support system control, data processing, and hardware interfacing.

• Consolidate and maintain heterogeneous firmware and its development environment (tools, build flow, and supporting infrastructure).

• Adapt the MPSoC architecture to support the required communication interfaces and onboard processing.

• Develop and integrate firmware updates to meet system functional and performance requirements.

• Perform functional tests to verify correct system behaviour under expected operating conditions.

• Develop dedicated electronic test boards and complex test benches to evaluate electronic systems under radiation at CERN and at external irradiation facilities.

• Characterise newly developed systems through measurement, analysis, and validation activities to ensure compliance with functional and performance requirements.

• Identify issues during testing, troubleshoot root causes, and implement corrective improvements.

• Collaborate with hardware, firmware, and software teams to ensure effective system integration and reliable operation.

• Ensure proper documentation, version control, and traceability of developments using collaborative tools such as GitLab and Jira.

Master's degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Electronics Engineering or a related field.

Experience:
 The following are required for this post:

• Complex HDL firmware development for FPGA, including implementation of data readout and data processing, HDL simulation, timing, and placement constraints.

• Software scripting and programming languages, particularly C and Python.

• Familiarity with digital design methodologies and verification flows, with experience in ASIC development.

• Practical knowledge of GitLab CI/CD pipelines, including build, test, and deployment automation.

• Demonstrated experience in mixed-signal electronics design, including analogue and digital board development.

• Experience in precision analogue front-end design and low-current measurement techniques.

• Experience with radiation monitoring tests and system characterisation under pulsed radiation fields is considered an asset.

• Ability to analyse test results, troubleshoot issues, identify root causes and implement corrective improvements is considered an asset.
 Technical competencies:

• Design and simulation of FPGA-based electronics.

• Design and simulation of front-end electronics for analogue sensors and transducers.

• Development of software for embedded and real-time systems with/without OS.

• Knowledge and application of instrumentation and measurement techniques.

• Design of ultra-low-current circuits.
 Behavioural competencies:

• Working in Teams: working well in groups and readily fitting into a team; participating fully and taking an active role in team activities.

• Learning and Sharing Knowledge: creating or participating in forums to exchange experience, comparing techniques and learn from others.

• Communicating Effectively: delivering presentations in a structured and clear way; adjusting style and content to the audience; responding calmly and confidently to questions.

• Achieving Results: dividing extensive work / projects into manageable sub-tasks with clearly defined milestones.

• Demonstrating Accountability: working conscientiously and reliably; delivering on promises.
 Language skills:
 Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Eligibility and closing date:
 Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
 This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 18.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST .
 Employment Conditions
 Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
 Working Hours: 40 hours per week
 Job Flexibility: Hybrid
 This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.
 Job grade: 6-7
 Job reference: HSE-TS-IMS-2026-161-LD
 Field of work: Electrical or Electronics Engineering
 Benchmark Job Title: Electronics Engineer

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
 Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
 Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione
Sei un ingegnere elettronico esperto e qualificato? Vuoi lavorare in una delle principali organizzazioni intergovernative scientifiche del mondo? Vieni a unire un ambiente unico il cui valore principale è l'eccellenza, e la cui caratteristica distintiva è il lavoro di squadra. CERN, partecipa!
Lavorerai nel TS-Group all'interno dell'unità HSE , responsabile della salute e della sicurezza sul lavoro, compresa la protezione dalle radiazioni, la protezione ambientale e la preparazione e la risposta di emergenza. Le attività riguardano il monitoraggio e la segnalazione degli impatti ambientali e radiologici delle attività dell’Organizzazione.
Nel vostro ruolo di ingegnere elettronico, sarete coinvolti nello sviluppo e nel miglioramento delle soluzioni di monitoraggio delle radiazioni e dell'ambiente. Questo include la partecipazione al ciclo di vita completo di hardware e sviluppo del firmware incorporato utilizzando metodologie e tecnologie moderne.
Funzioni

• Progettare e sviluppare elettronica di segnale misto, con un focus sulle interfacce dei sensori analogici e sui circuiti di misura ultra-bassa corrente.

• Sviluppare e mantenere il codice incorporato in VHDL e C per supportare il controllo del sistema, l'elaborazione dei dati e l'interfaccia hardware.

• Consolidare e mantenere il firmware eterogeneo e il suo ambiente di sviluppo (tool, costruire il flusso e sostenere l'infrastruttura).

• Adapt l'architettura MPSoC per supportare le interfacce di comunicazione richieste e l'elaborazione a bordo.

• Sviluppare e integrare gli aggiornamenti del firmware per soddisfare i requisiti funzionali e di prestazioni del sistema.

• Eseguire test funzionali per verificare il corretto comportamento del sistema in condizioni operative previste.

• Sviluppare tavole di prova elettroniche dedicate e banchi di prova complessi per valutare i sistemi elettronici sotto radiazione al CERN e alle strutture di irradiazione esterne.

• Caratterizzate i nuovi sistemi attraverso attività di misura, analisi e validazione per garantire il rispetto dei requisiti funzionali e prestazionali.

• Identificare i problemi durante il test, risolvere i problemi cause root e implementare miglioramenti correttivi.

• Collabora con team hardware, firmware e software per garantire un'efficace integrazione del sistema e un funzionamento affidabile.

• Assicurare la corretta documentazione, il controllo delle versioni e la tracciabilità degli sviluppi utilizzando strumenti collaborativi come GitLab e Jira.

Laurea magistrale o dottorato o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo dell'ingegneria elettronica o di un campo relativo.

Esperienza:
Per questo post sono richiesti i seguenti:

• Sviluppo del firmware HDL complesso per FPGA, compresa l'implementazione di lettura dei dati e elaborazione dei dati, simulazione HDL, tempistica e vincoli di posizionamento.

• Software di scrittura e linguaggi di programmazione, in particolare C e Python.

• Familiarità con metodologie di progettazione digitale e flussi di verifica, con esperienza nello sviluppo ASIC.

• Conoscenza pratica delle pipeline GitLab CI/CD, tra cui automazione di costruzione, test e distribuzione.

• Esperienza dimostrata nel design dell'elettronica mista, incluso lo sviluppo di schede analogiche e digitali.

• Esperienza nella progettazione frontale analogica di precisione e nelle tecniche di misura a bassa corrente.

• L'esperienza con i test di monitoraggio delle radiazioni e la caratterizzazione del sistema in campi di radiazione pulsata è considerata un bene.

• La capacità di analizzare i risultati dei test, risolvere i problemi, identificare le cause della radice e implementare miglioramenti correttivi è considerato un bene.
Competenze tecniche:

• Progettazione e simulazione di elettronica basata su FPGA.

• Progettazione e simulazione di elettronica front-end per sensori e trasduttori analogici.

• Sviluppo di software per sistemi incorporati e in tempo reale con/senza sistema operativo.

• Conoscenza e applicazione delle tecniche di strumentazione e misura.

• Progettazione di circuiti ultra-bassi.
Competenze comportamentali:

• Lavorare in team: lavorare bene in gruppi e adattarsi prontamente a un team; partecipare pienamente e assumere un ruolo attivo nelle attività del team.

• Conoscenza di apprendimento e condivisione: creare o partecipare a forum per scambiare esperienze, confrontare tecniche e imparare da altri.

• Comunicare efficacemente: fornire presentazioni in modo strutturato e chiaro; regolare lo stile e il contenuto al pubblico; rispondere con calma e con fiducia alle domande.

• Risultati ottenuti: dividendo lavori / progetti in sub-task gestibili con pietre miliari ben definite.

• Dimostrare la Responsabilità: lavorare in modo coscienzioso e affidabile; fornire promesse.
Capacità linguistiche:
Parlato e scritto inglese o francese, con un impegno per imparare l'altra lingua.

Ammissibilità e chiusura:
La diversità è parte integrante della missione del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione ed è un valore consolidato dell'Organizzazione. Sfruttare una forza lavoro diversificata è fondamentale per il nostro successo. Accogliamo con favore le domande di tutti gli Stati membri e degli Stati membri associati.
Questa vacanza sarà riempita il prima possibile, e le applicazioni dovrebbero normalmente raggiungerci non oltre 18.08.2026 a 23:59 CEST .
Condizioni di lavoro
Tipo di contratto: contratto di durata limitata (5 anni). Fatto salvo determinate condizioni, i titolari di contratti a durata limitata possono richiedere una posizione a tempo indeterminato.
Orario di lavoro: 40 ore a settimana
Flessibilità del lavoro: ibrido
Questa posizione comporta:

• Lavoro nelle aree di radiazione.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction
Are you a skilled and experienced electronics engineer? Do you want to work in one of the world’s leading scientific Intergovernmental Organisations? Come and join a unique environment whose core value is excellence, and whose defining characteristic is teamwork. CERN, take part!
You will work in the TS-Group within the  HSE Unit , which is responsible for occupational health and safety, including radiation protection, environmental protection, and emergency preparedness and response. Activities cover the monitoring and reporting of the environmental and radiological impacts of the Organization’s activities.
In your role as an electronics engineer, you will be involved in the development and improvement of radiation and environmental monitoring solutions. This includes participating in the full lifecycle of hardware and embedded firmware development using modern methodologies and technologies.
Functions

• Design and develop mixed-signal electronics, with a focus on analogue sensor interfaces and ultra-low-current measurement circuits.

• Develop and maintain embedded code in VHDL and C to support system control, data processing, and hardware interfacing.

• Consolidate and maintain heterogeneous firmware and its development environment (tools, build flow, and supporting infrastructure).

• Adapt the MPSoC architecture to support the required communication interfaces and onboard processing.

• Develop and integrate firmware updates to meet system functional and performance requirements.

• Perform functional tests to verify correct system behaviour under expected operating conditions.

• Develop dedicated electronic test boards and complex test benches to evaluate electronic systems under radiation at CERN and at external irradiation facilities.

• Characterise newly developed systems through measurement, analysis, and validation activities to ensure compliance with functional and performance requirements.

• Identify issues during testing, troubleshoot root causes, and implement corrective improvements.

• Collaborate with hardware, firmware, and software teams to ensure effective system integration and reliable operation.

• Ensure proper documentation, version control, and traceability of developments using collaborative tools such as GitLab and Jira.

Master's degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Electronics Engineering or a related field.

Experience:
The following are required for this post:

• Complex HDL firmware development for FPGA, including implementation of data readout and data processing, HDL simulation, timing, and placement constraints.

• Software scripting and programming languages, particularly C and Python.

• Familiarity with digital design methodologies and verification flows, with experience in ASIC development.

• Practical knowledge of GitLab CI/CD pipelines, including build, test, and deployment automation.

• Demonstrated experience in mixed-signal electronics design, including analogue and digital board development.

• Experience in precision analogue front-end design and low-current measurement techniques.

• Experience with radiation monitoring tests and system characterisation under pulsed radiation fields is considered an asset.

• Ability to analyse test results, troubleshoot issues, identify root causes and implement corrective improvements is considered an asset.
Technical competencies:

• Design and simulation of FPGA-based electronics.

• Design and simulation of front-end electronics for analogue sensors and transducers.

• Development of software for embedded and real-time systems with/without OS.

• Knowledge and application of instrumentation and measurement techniques.

• Design of ultra-low-current circuits.
Behavioural competencies:

• Working in Teams: working well in groups and readily fitting into a team; participating fully and taking an active role in team activities.

• Learning and Sharing Knowledge: creating or participating in forums to exchange experience, comparing techniques and learn from others.

• Communicating Effectively: delivering presentations in a structured and clear way; adjusting style and content to the audience; responding calmly and confidently to questions.

• Achieving Results: dividing extensive work / projects into manageable sub-tasks with clearly defined milestones.

• Demonstrating Accountability: working conscientiously and reliably; delivering on promises.
Language skills:
Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 18.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST .
Employment Conditions
Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Job Flexibility: Hybrid
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.
Job grade: 6-7
Job reference: HSE-TS-IMS-2026-161-LD
Field of work: Electrical or Electronics Engineering
Benchmark Job Title: Electronics Engineer

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
More information about us, here: careers.cern

Einleitung
Sind Sie ein erfahrener und erfahrener Elektronikingenieur? Möchten Sie in einer der weltweit führenden wissenschaftlichen zwischenstaatlichen Organisationen arbeiten? Treten Sie einer einzigartigen Umgebung bei, deren Kernwert Exzellenz ist und deren definierendes Merkmal Teamarbeit ist. CERN, nehmen Sie teil!
Sie arbeiten in der TS-Group innerhalb der HSE Unit, die für den Arbeitsschutz, einschließlich Strahlenschutz, Umweltschutz sowie Notfallvorsorge und -reaktion zuständig ist. Die Aktivitäten umfassen die Überwachung und Berichterstattung über die Umwelt- und radiologischen Auswirkungen der Aktivitäten der Organisation.
In Ihrer Rolle als Elektronikingenieur sind Sie an der Entwicklung und Verbesserung von Strahlungs- und Umweltüberwachungslösungen beteiligt. Dazu gehört die Teilnahme am gesamten Lebenszyklus der Hardware- und Embedded-Firmware-Entwicklung unter Verwendung moderner Methoden und Technologien.
Funktionen

• Design und Entwicklung von Mixed-Signal-Elektronik mit Schwerpunkt auf analogen Sensorschnittstellen und Ultra-Niedrigstrom-Messkreisen.

• Entwicklung und Pflege von eingebettetem Code in VHDL und C zur Unterstützung von Systemsteuerung, Datenverarbeitung und Hardwareschnittstellen.

• Konsolidieren und pflegen Sie heterogene Firmware und ihre Entwicklungsumgebung (Tools, Build-Flow und unterstützende Infrastruktur).

• Passen Sie die MPSoC-Architektur an, um die erforderlichen Kommunikationsschnittstellen und die Onboard-Verarbeitung zu unterstützen.

• Entwickeln und integrieren Sie Firmware-Updates, um die Funktions- und Leistungsanforderungen des Systems zu erfüllen.

• Führen Sie Funktionstests durch, um das korrekte Systemverhalten unter den erwarteten Betriebsbedingungen zu überprüfen.

• Entwicklung spezieller elektronischer Prüftafeln und komplexer Prüfstände zur Bewertung elektronischer Systeme unter Strahlung am CERN und an externen Bestrahlungsanlagen.

• Charakterisierung neu entwickelter Systeme durch Mess-, Analyse- und Validierungsaktivitäten, um die Einhaltung der Funktions- und Leistungsanforderungen sicherzustellen.

• Identifizieren Sie Probleme während des Tests, beheben Sie Ursachen und implementieren Sie Korrekturverbesserungen.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Hardware-, Firmware- und Softwareteams zusammen, um eine effektive Systemintegration und einen zuverlässigen Betrieb zu gewährleisten.

• Gewährleistung einer ordnungsgemäßen Dokumentation, Versionskontrolle und Rückverfolgbarkeit von Entwicklungen mithilfe von kollaborativen Tools wie GitLab und Jira.

Master-Abschluss oder PhD oder gleichwertige einschlägige Erfahrung im Bereich der Elektroniktechnik oder einem verwandten Bereich.

Erfahrung:
Für diesen Posten ist Folgendes erforderlich:

• Komplexe HDL-Firmware-Entwicklung für FPGA, einschließlich Implementierung von Datenauslesen und Datenverarbeitung, HDL-Simulation, Timing und Platzierungsbeschränkungen.

• Software-Scripting und Programmiersprachen, insbesondere C und Python.

• Vertrautheit mit digitalen Designmethoden und Verifikationsflüssen, mit Erfahrung in der ASIC-Entwicklung.

• Praktische Kenntnisse von GitLab CI/CD-Pipelines, einschließlich Build-, Test- und Deployment-Automatisierung.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Design von Mixed-Signal-Elektronik, einschließlich analoger und digitaler Boardentwicklung.

• Erfahrung im präzisen analogen Frontend-Design und in Niederstrom-Messtechniken.

• Erfahrungen mit Strahlungsüberwachungstests und Systemcharakterisierung unter gepulsten Strahlungsfeldern gelten als wertvoll.

• Die Fähigkeit, Testergebnisse zu analysieren, Probleme zu beheben, Ursachen zu identifizieren und korrigierende Verbesserungen zu implementieren, gilt als eine Bereicherung.
Technische Kompetenzen:

• Design und Simulation von FPGA-basierter Elektronik.

• Design und Simulation von Frontend-Elektronik für analoge Sensoren und Wandler.

• Entwicklung von Software für eingebettete und Echtzeitsysteme mit/ohne Betriebssystem.

• Kenntnisse und Anwendung von Mess- und Messtechniken.

• Entwurf von Niederstromkreisen.
Verhaltenskompetenzen:

• Arbeiten in Teams: gut in Gruppen arbeiten und sich leicht in ein Team einfügen; vollständig teilnehmen und eine aktive Rolle bei Teamaktivitäten übernehmen.

• Lernen und Teilen von Wissen: Erstellen oder Teilnahme an Foren, um Erfahrungen auszutauschen, Techniken zu vergleichen und von anderen zu lernen.

• Effektiv kommunizieren: Präsentationen auf strukturierte und klare Weise liefern; Stil und Inhalt an das Publikum anpassen; ruhig und selbstbewusst auf Fragen reagieren.

• Ergebnisse erzielen: Aufteilung umfangreicher Arbeiten / Projekte in überschaubare Teilaufgaben mit klar definierten Meilensteinen.

• Nachweis der Rechenschaftspflicht: gewissenhaft und zuverlässig arbeiten; Versprechen halten.
Sprachkenntnisse:
Gesprochen und geschrieben Englisch oder Französisch, mit der Verpflichtung, die andere Sprache zu lernen.

Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein integraler Bestandteil der Mission des CERN und ist ein fester Wert der Organisation. Die Beschäftigung einer vielfältigen Belegschaft ist zentral für unseren Erfolg. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen aus allen Mitgliedstaaten und assoziierten Mitgliedstaaten.

Globale Vorteile

Bei CERN, der Europäischen Organisation für Kernforschung, erweitern wir die Grenzen von Wissenschaft und Technologie. Cela comprend la participation à l'ensemble du cycle de vie du matériel et du firmware intégré en utilisant des méthodologies et des technologies modernes.
Fonctions

• Concevoir et développer l'électronique à signal mixte, en mettant l'accent sur les interfaces de capteurs analogiques et les circuits de mesure à courant ultra-faible.

• Développez et maintenez le code intégré dans VHDL et C pour soutenir le contrôle du système, le traitement des données et l'interface matérielle.

• Consolider et maintenir un firmware hétérogène et son environnement de développement (outils, flux de construction et infrastructure de soutien).

• Adapter l'architecture MPSoC pour supporter les interfaces de communication et le traitement embarqué requis.

• Effectuer des essais fonctionnels pour vérifier le comportement correct du système dans les conditions de fonctionnement prévues.

• Développer des planches d'essai électroniques et des bancs d'essai complexes pour évaluer les systèmes électroniques sous rayonnement au CERN et dans les installations d'irradiation externe.

• Identifier les problèmes lors des essais, résoudre les causes profondes et mettre en oeuvre des améliorations correctives.

Maîtrise ou doctorat ou expérience pertinente équivalente dans le domaine du génie électronique ou dans un domaine connexe.

• Développement de logiciels pour les systèmes embarqués et en temps réel avec/sans OS.

jobs.description:
Are you a skilled hardware support engineer? Does taking the responsibility of running an infrastructure dedicated to accelerating the development of cutting-edge computing technologies for the research community challenge you? Then, join the Fabric and Communication Systems (FCS) group in charge of procuring, managing, and operating the layer providing IT equipment for the CERN experiments and users community, the Data Centres and associated Computing Facilities.
 Your responsibilities
 As a successful candidate you will be :

• Ensuring the smooth and reliable operation of this infrastructure. You will actively take part in the commissioning of new systems, in particular the ones part of the computing cluster for the Next Generation Triggers project.

• Running hardware evaluation (including benchmarking activities) and providing support to the user community.

• Focus on the deployment and operations of systems equipped with accelerator cards such as enterprise grade GPU.

• Maintain the existing servers, ensuring optimal performance through regular maintenance and upgrades.
 Additional opportunities include:

• Interact on a regular basis with industry partners and be exposed to novel technologies.

• Organise topic-oriented workshops.
 Your profile

• Proven experience with computer systems (BIOS/UEFI, x86/Arm processor architectures and virtualization, memory, GPU computing), interconnects (Ethernet, Infiniband) and types of storage drives (S-ATA, SAS, NVMe).

• Experience with management and monitoring protocols such as, but not limited to, IPMI / Redfish, SMART and SNMP.

• Extensive experience with Linux and shell scripting.

• Demonstrated experience with Python.
 Skills
 Skills and/or knowledge:

• Server hardware.

• Python.

• Shell scripting.

• Linux system administration.
 Additional assets:

• Familiarity with performance profiling and optimisation of applications.

• Demonstrating the ability to perform performance-oriented debugging.

• Proficiency (or willingness to rapidly acquire it) in utilising software configuration management tools, such as Puppet or Ansible.

• The ability to work in French would be an advantage.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria:

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Computer Science / Computer Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants without University degree are not eligible.

• Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

Unisciti al team IT Cloud di CERN e aiuta a gestire e sviluppare l'infrastruttura cloud basata su OpenStack che supporta la maggior parte dei servizi di esperimento CERN e LHC. In questo ruolo, lavorerai sui sistemi e software che forniscono capacità di elaborazione, archiviazione, networking e automazione a migliaia di utenti in tutta l'organizzazione.
Potrai collaborare a stretto contatto con gli ingegneri esperti, la comunità OpenStack a monte e le diverse comunità di utenti del CERN, acquisendo esperienza pratica operativa e in evoluzione una delle più grandi nuvole scientifiche del mondo. Dall'affidabilità del servizio e dall'automazione allo sviluppo e alle operazioni su larga scala, vi aiuterà a fornire infrastrutture che consentano una ricerca all'avanguardia.
Se ti piace risolvere complesse sfide tecniche, contribuire al software open source, e lavorare con l'infrastruttura in scala, unirsi a noi!
Le tue responsabilità

• Eseguire e aiutare a evolvere l'infrastruttura cloud basata su OpenStack del CERN IT.

• Contribuisci al funzionamento e allo sviluppo dei servizi cloud, inclusi componenti di elaborazione, storage, networking e infrastrutture correlate.

• Sviluppare e mantenere l'automazione e lo strumento utilizzando Python e sistemi di gestione della configurazione.

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con altri team IT e comunità degli utenti per progettare e integrare nuove funzionalità e servizi.

• Contribuisci correzioni di bug e miglioramenti a monte, sfruttando i forti legami del CERN con la comunità open-source di OpenStack.

• Partecipa alla risoluzione dei problemi e all'ottimizzazione delle prestazioni dei sistemi distribuiti su larga scala.

• Migliorare ulteriormente l'automazione del servizio per garantire scalabilità e gestibilità.
Il tuo profilo

• Esperienza di gestione o di lavoro con sistemi Linux in un ambiente server o data-centre.

• Esperienza di scrittura script Python o applicazioni per l'automazione o le attività di sistemi.

• La familiarità con le piattaforme cloud, le tecnologie di virtualizzazione o i sistemi distribuiti è un plus.

• Esperienza con strumenti di gestione della configurazione come Puppet o Ansible è un plus.

• L'esperienza con le tecnologie dei container, i sistemi CI/CD o la rete software-defined è un vantaggio.

• I contributi ai progetti open source o alle comunità a monte sono un vantaggio.
Competenze

• Forte conoscenza del sistema operativo Linux.

• Esperienza con controllo versione git.

• Esperienza di programmazione in Python.

• Interessi nell'infrastruttura cloud e nei sistemi distribuiti su larga scala.

• La familiarità con i sistemi di gestione della configurazione (ad esempio Puppet o Ansible) è un vantaggio.

• La comprensione dei concetti di rete e delle tecnologie di storage è un vantaggio.

• Capacità di collaborare in un team multidisciplinare, internazionale e comunicare con chiarezza.

• Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese.
Criteri di ammissibilità:

• Sei un cittadino di uno Stato membro del CERN o di uno Stato membro associato .

• Con la scadenza dell'applicazione, si dispone di un massimo di due anni di esperienza professionale dalla laurea in Informatica o un campo correlato (o un campo correlato) e la vostra più alta qualifica educativa è sia una laurea o master.

• Non hai mai avuto un contratto di laurea o di socio del CERN.

• I candidati senza laurea non sono ammissibili.

• I candidati con un dottorato non sono ammissibili.

Data di chiusura del lavoro: 10.08.2026 alle 23:59 CEST.
Durata del contratto: 24 mesi, con una possibile estensione fino a 36 mesi massimo.
Orario di lavoro: 40 ore settimanali
Flessibilità del lavoro: ibrido
Data di inizio obiettivo: 01-Novembre-2026
Riferimento del lavoro: IT-CD-CLI-2026-180-GRAE
Campo di lavoro: Ingegneria del software e IT
Lavoro Benchmark: 200020 - Ingegnere di calcolo

Vantaggi globali

• Una spesa mensile tra 5266-5793 Franco Svizzero al mese (gratuito dalla tassa) a seconda della laurea.

• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.

• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.

• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.

• Un pacchetto di trasferimento (concessione di installazione e spese di viaggio) a seconda delle vostre circostanze individuali.

• Possibilità di estendere il contratto fino a 36 mesi.

• Formazione on-the-job e formale, comprese le lezioni di lingua.
Panoramica del CERN - Scopri un mondo in cui l'impossibile è reso possibile!
Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano.
Ogni giorno, affrontiamo nuove sfide e opportunità entusiasmanti per contribuire alla ricerca all'avanguardia che plasma la nostra comprensione dell'universo. Incontriamo queste sfide attraverso le diverse prospettive all'interno dei nostri team, assicurando che ogni contributo sia valutato e guida il nostro senso condiviso di inclusione e scopo. La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione, e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e il successo continuo.
Se siete pronti a far parte di una comunità dinamica e inclusiva che spinge i confini della conoscenza, il CERN è il luogo in cui la vostra curiosità e abilità possono prosperare. Fate parte della nostra missione per scoprire cosa sta nel cuore dell'universo! Partita!

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you passionate about cloud infrastructure and curious about how large-scale services are operated and evolved? Join CERN's IT Cloud team and help run and develop the OpenStack-based cloud infrastructure that underpins most CERN and LHC experiment services. In this role, you will work on the systems and software that provide compute, storage, networking and automation capabilities to thousands of users across the organisation.
You will collaborate closely with experienced engineers, the upstream OpenStack community, and CERN's diverse user communities, gaining hands-on experience operating and evolving one of the world's largest scientific clouds. From service reliability and automation to feature development and large-scale operations, you will help deliver infrastructure that enables cutting-edge research.
If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, contributing to open-source software, and working with infrastructure at scale, come join us!
Your responsibilities

• Run and help evolve CERN IT's OpenStack-based cloud infrastructure.

• Contribute to the operation and development of cloud services, including compute, storage, networking and related infrastructure components.

• Develop and maintain automation and tooling using Python and configuration management systems.

• Work closely with other IT teams and user communities to design and integrate new capabilities and services.

• Contribute bug fixes and improvements upstream, leveraging CERN's strong links with the OpenStack open-source community.

• Participate in troubleshooting and performance optimisation of large-scale distributed systems.

• Further enhance the service's automation to ensure scalability and manageability.
Your profile

• Experience administering or working with Linux systems in a server or data-centre environment.

• Experience writing Python scripts or applications for automation or systems tasks.

• Familiarity with cloud platforms, virtualisation technologies or distributed systems is a plus.

• Experience with configuration management tools such as Puppet or Ansible is a plus.

• Experience with container technologies, CI/CD systems or software-defined networking is a plus.

• Contributions to open-source projects or upstream communities are a plus.
Skills

• Strong knowledge of the Linux operating system.

• Experience with git version control.

• Programming experience in Python.

• Interest in cloud infrastructure and large-scale distributed systems.

• Familiarity with configuration management systems (e.g. Puppet or Ansible) is a plus.

• Understanding of networking concepts and storage technologies is a plus.

• Ability to collaborate in a multidisciplinary, international team and communicate clearly.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Computer Science or a related field (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants without University degree are not eligible.

• Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

Job closing date: 10.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Hybrid
Target start date: 01-November-2026
Job reference: IT-CD-CLI-2026-180-GRAE
Field of work: Software Engineering and IT
Benchmark job: 200020 - Computing Engineer

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 5266-5793 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
More information about us, here: careers.cern
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sie interessieren sich für Cloud-Infrastruktur und sind neugierig darauf, wie große Dienste betrieben und weiterentwickelt werden? In dieser Rolle arbeiten Sie an Systemen und Software, die Rechen-, Speicher-, Netzwerk- und Automatisierungsfunktionen für Tausende von Benutzern im gesamten Unternehmen bereitstellen.
Sie arbeiten eng mit erfahrenen Ingenieuren, der Upstream-OpenStack-Community und den vielfältigen Benutzergemeinschaften des CERN zusammen und sammeln praktische Erfahrungen mit dem Betrieb und der Entwicklung einer der größten wissenschaftlichen Clouds der Welt. Von Servicezuverlässigkeit und Automatisierung bis hin zur Feature-Entwicklung und zum Großbetrieb tragen Sie zur Bereitstellung einer Infrastruktur bei, die Spitzenforschung ermöglicht.
Wenn Sie gerne komplexe technische Herausforderungen lösen, zu Open-Source-Software beitragen und mit Infrastruktur in großem Maßstab arbeiten, kommen Sie zu uns!
Ihre Verantwortung

• Führen und unterstützen Sie die OpenStack-basierte Cloud-Infrastruktur von CERN IT.

• Beitrag zum Betrieb und zur Entwicklung von Cloud-Services, einschließlich Compute-, Storage-, Networking- und zugehörigen Infrastrukturkomponenten.

• Entwicklung und Wartung von Automatisierung und Tools mit Python und Konfigurationsmanagementsystemen.

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit anderen IT-Teams und Benutzergemeinschaften zusammen, um neue Funktionen und Dienste zu entwerfen und zu integrieren.

• Tragen Sie Bugfixes und Verbesserungen vorgelagert bei und nutzen Sie die starken Verbindungen des CERN zur Open-Source-Community.

• Beteiligen Sie sich an der Fehlersuche und Leistungsoptimierung von großen verteilten Systemen.

• Weitere Verbesserung der Automatisierung des Dienstes, um Skalierbarkeit und Verwaltbarkeit zu gewährleisten.

• Erfahrung mit Konfigurationsmanagement-Tools wie Puppet oder Ansible ist ein Plus.

• Erfahrung mit Container-Technologien, CI/CD-Systemen oder softwaredefinierter Vernetzung ist ein Plus.

• Beiträge zu Open-Source-Projekten oder Upstream-Communities sind ein Plus.
Fähigkeiten

• Gute Kenntnisse des Linux-Betriebssystems.

• Erfahrung mit git Versionskontrolle.

• Programmiererfahrung in Python.

• Interesse an Cloud-Infrastruktur und großen verteilten Systemen.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about infrastructure at scale and curious about how bare metal servers are managed across a fleet of 10'000 nodes? Join CERN's IT Cloud team and help run and evolve the OpenStack-based cloud infrastructure that underpins most CERN and LHC experiment services.
 In this role, you will work at the intersection of systems engineering and software development, contributing to the life-cycle management of physical servers (from delivery and burn-in to provisioning and phase-out) using OpenStack Ironic.
 You will collaborate closely with senior engineers, the upstream OpenStack community, and CERN's diverse user communities, gaining deep hands-on experience with bare metal provisioning, BMC protocols, and Python development in a large-scale production environment.
 If you enjoy working close to the hardware, contributing to open-source projects, and solving real operational challenges at scale, come join us!
 Your responsibilities

• Run and help evolve CERN IT's OpenStack-based cloud infrastructure.

• Maintain and develop the bare metal life-cycle management framework built on OpenStack Ironic: integrate new server deliveries, provision nodes to user communities, and maintain tooling for burn-in, stress-testing and phase-out.

• Contribute to the upstream OpenStack/Ironic code base, leveraging CERN's links with the open-source community.

• Collaborate on automation and tooling improvements using Python and configuration management systems.
 Your profile

• Experience administering or working with Linux systems in a server or data-centre environment.

• Experience writing Python scripts or applications for automation or systems tasks.

• Familiarity with configuration management tools such as Puppet or Ansible is a plus.

• Experience with bare metal server management, BMC protocols (IPMI, Redfish) or hardware provisioning workflows is a plus.

• Contributions to open-source projects or upstream communities is a plus.
 Skills

• Strong knowledge of the Linux operating system.

• Experience with git version control.

• Programming experience in Python.

• Interest in bare metal infrastructure and hardware life-cycle management.

• Familiarity with configuration management systems (e.g. Puppet or Ansible) is a plus.

• Experience with management of physical servers or BMC protocols such as IPMI or Redfish is a plus.

• Ability to collaborate in a multidisciplinary, international team and communicate clearly.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Computer Science or a related field (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants without University degree are not eligible.

• Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

• Configure the IT department's newly contracted external cloud services (i.e. AWS, GCP, Azure and Oracle) such that their functionality and data maximally benefit from all relevant inherent security settings.

• Review, in addition, the current security posture and configuration of CERN's existing Microsoft and Google SaaS cloud configurations.

• Ideally, but in addition, experience in monitoring and responding to security threats and incidents for ICT systems.

• Excellent knowledge of the Linux/UNIX operating system, virtualisation, databases, and in particular of shell scripting and programming (Python, and/or C), other languages or technologies would be a plus.

jobs.description:
Introduction:
 Within the CERN Engineering department (EN), the Cooling and Ventilation ( EN-CV ) group is responsible for the design, the building, the operation, and the maintenance of the cooling and ventilation plants for large energy physics accelerators, experiments, and technical facilities. The EN-CV group pursues sustainable cooling and ventilation systems enhancing energy saving and recovery.

You will join the Project Section (EN-CV-PJ), which is in charge of coordination and management of cooling and ventilation projects for installation of new systems, upgrade of existing systems and consolidation of old systems both for CERN accelerators and experiments.

The section is responsible for entire project cycles, starting from collecting user requirements to the final commissioning of cooling and ventilation systems.
 Functions:

• Pursue and define user requirements from main stakeholders.

• Perform feasibility studies and detailed designs of industrial cooling and HVAC systems, including sizing and cost estimates for the proposed solutions.

• Write up technical reports and notes.

• Draw up technical specifications and all relevant documents, follow up the tendering process up to the adjudication of future contracts.

• Follow up and regularly report on the project's progress.

• Ensure technical coordination and supervision of contractors.

• Monitor cost and schedule up to the commissioning and formal acceptance of the systems.

• Support operation teams in the troubleshooting and process improvement of existing plants.

• Actively contribute to the development and improvement of the internal procedures, technical prescriptions, and standardisation of the technical solutions.

• Master's Degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

• Certification in project management (PMP/PMI) would be an asset.
 Experience:

• Demonstrated experience in the design, construction and testing of industrial cooling systems including experience in selecting related equipment and instrumentation.

• Initial experience in the design, construction and testing of HVAC installations and their related hydraulic components.

• Proven experience in contract management.

• Demonstrated experience in project management.
 Technical competencies:

• Design and construction of cooling water systems: (cooling tower, demineralised and chilled water) and networks including test of plants and their associated equipment.

• Design and construction of HVAC plants and networks: including test of plant and associated equipment.

• Water cooling process design and analysis: as well as HVAC process.

• Project management.

• Contract management.

• Managing Self: working well autonomously; taking on activities and tasks without prompting.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione:
All'interno del reparto CERN Engineering (EN), il gruppo Cooling and Ventilation (EN-CV) è responsabile per la progettazione, l'edificio, il funzionamento, e la manutenzione degli impianti di raffreddamento e ventilazione per grandi acceleratori di fisica dell'energia, esperimenti e impianti tecnici. Il gruppo EN-CV persegue sistemi di raffreddamento e ventilazione sostenibili che migliorano il risparmio energetico e il recupero.

Ti unirai alla sezione Progetto (EN-CV-PJ), che è responsabile del coordinamento e della gestione di progetti di raffreddamento e ventilazione per l'installazione di nuovi sistemi, l'aggiornamento dei sistemi esistenti e il consolidamento di vecchi sistemi sia per acceleratori CERN che per esperimenti.

La sezione è responsabile di interi cicli di progetto, partendo dalla raccolta dei requisiti degli utenti alla messa in servizio finale dei sistemi di raffreddamento e ventilazione.
Funzioni:

• Acquisire e definire i requisiti degli utenti dai principali stakeholder.

• Eseguire studi di fattibilità e progetti dettagliati di raffreddamento industriale e sistemi HVAC, tra cui dimensionamento e stime dei costi per le soluzioni proposte.

• Scrivi report tecnici e note.

• Definire le specifiche tecniche e tutti i documenti pertinenti, seguire il processo di aggiudicazione fino all'aggiudicazione dei contratti futuri.

• Seguire e regolarmente riferire sui progressi del progetto.

• Assicurare il coordinamento tecnico e la supervisione degli appaltatori.

• Monitorare i costi e la pianificazione fino alla messa in servizio e l'accettazione formale dei sistemi.

• Squadre di funzionamento di supporto nella risoluzione dei problemi e il miglioramento del processo degli impianti esistenti.

• Contribuire attivamente allo sviluppo e al miglioramento delle procedure interne, delle prescrizioni tecniche e della standardizzazione delle soluzioni tecniche.

• Master's Degree o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo dell'ingegneria meccanica o un campo correlato.

• La certificazione nella gestione del progetto (PMP/PMI) sarebbe un bene.
Esperienza:

• Esperienza dimostrata nella progettazione, costruzione e collaudo di sistemi di raffreddamento industriale, compresa l'esperienza nella selezione di attrezzature e strumentazione correlati.

• Esperienza iniziale nella progettazione, costruzione e collaudo di impianti HVAC e dei relativi componenti idraulici.

• Esperienza comprovata nella gestione dei contratti.

• Esperienza dimostrata nella gestione del progetto.
Competenze tecniche:

• Progettazione e costruzione di impianti di raffreddamento: (Torre di raffreddamento, acqua demineralizzata e refrigerata) e reti tra cui test di impianti e loro attrezzature associate.

• Progettazione e costruzione di impianti e reti HVAC: compresa la prova di impianti e attrezzature associate.

• Progettazione e analisi del processo di raffreddamento ad acqua: così come processo HVAC.

• Gestione dei progetti.

• Gestione dei contratti.
Competenze comportamentali:

• Realizzare risultati: avere un approccio strutturato e organizzato verso il lavoro; essere in grado di fissare priorità e pianificare i compiti con i risultati in mente.

• Comunicare efficacemente: garantire che le informazioni, le procedure e le decisioni siano adeguatamente documentate.

• Dimostrare Flessibilità: assorbire prontamente nuove tecniche e pratiche di lavoro; proporre nuovi o migliori metodi di lavoro.

• Gestire il Sé: lavorare bene autonomamente; svolgere attività e compiti senza sollecitare.

• Lavorare in team: capire quando il lavoro di squadra è necessario per ottenere i migliori risultati; anche altri di conseguenza e condividere le informazioni.
Capacità linguistiche:

• Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese.

Questa posizione comporta:

Panoramica del CERN - Scopri un mondo in cui l'impossibile è reso possibile!
Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Incontriamo queste sfide attraverso le diverse prospettive all'interno dei nostri team, assicurando che ogni contributo sia valutato e guida il nostro senso condiviso di inclusione e scopo. La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione, e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e il successo continuo.
Se siete pronti a far parte di una comunità dinamica e inclusiva che spinge i confini della conoscenza, il CERN è il luogo in cui la vostra curiosità e abilità possono prosperare. Fate parte della nostra missione per scoprire cosa sta nel cuore dell'universo! Partita!

descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction:
Within the CERN Engineering department (EN), the Cooling and Ventilation ( EN-CV ) group is responsible for the design, the building, the operation, and the maintenance of the cooling and ventilation plants for large energy physics accelerators, experiments, and technical facilities. The EN-CV group pursues sustainable cooling and ventilation systems enhancing energy saving and recovery.

You will join the Project Section (EN-CV-PJ), which is in charge of coordination and management of cooling and ventilation projects for installation of new systems, upgrade of existing systems and consolidation of old systems both for CERN accelerators and experiments.

The section is responsible for entire project cycles, starting from collecting user requirements to the final commissioning of cooling and ventilation systems.
Functions:

• Pursue and define user requirements from main stakeholders.

• Perform feasibility studies and detailed designs of industrial cooling and HVAC systems, including sizing and cost estimates for the proposed solutions.

• Write up technical reports and notes.

• Draw up technical specifications and all relevant documents, follow up the tendering process up to the adjudication of future contracts.

• Follow up and regularly report on the project's progress.

• Ensure technical coordination and supervision of contractors.

• Monitor cost and schedule up to the commissioning and formal acceptance of the systems.

• Support operation teams in the troubleshooting and process improvement of existing plants.

• Actively contribute to the development and improvement of the internal procedures, technical prescriptions, and standardisation of the technical solutions.

• Master's Degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

• Certification in project management (PMP/PMI) would be an asset.
Experience:

• Demonstrated experience in the design, construction and testing of industrial cooling systems including experience in selecting related equipment and instrumentation.

• Initial experience in the design, construction and testing of HVAC installations and their related hydraulic components.

• Proven experience in contract management.

• Demonstrated experience in project management.
Technical competencies:

• Design and construction of cooling water systems: (cooling tower, demineralised and chilled water) and networks including test of plants and their associated equipment.

• Design and construction of HVAC plants and networks: including test of plant and associated equipment.

• Water cooling process design and analysis: as well as HVAC process.

• Project management.

• Contract management.
Behavioural competencies:

• Achieving Results: having a structured and organised approach towards work; being able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.

• Communicating Effectively: ensuring that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: readily absorbing new techniques and working practices; proposing new or improved ways of working.

• Managing Self: working well autonomously; taking on activities and tasks without prompting.

• Working in Teams: understanding when teamwork is required to achieve the best results; including others accordingly and sharing information.
Language skills:

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 19.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Employment Conditions:
Contract type: Limited duration contract (4 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Shift work, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Stand-by duty, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Exposure to risk of falling from heights during scaffolding assembly and dismantling operations.

• Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions.

• Shift work.

• Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
Job grade: 6-7
Job reference: EN-CV-PJ-2026-162-LD
Field of work: Mechanical Engineering
Benchmark Job Title: Mechanical Engineer

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
More information about us, here: careers.cern
descriptionByLocale.de:
Einleitung:
Innerhalb des CERN Engineering Department (EN) ist die Gruppe Cooling and Ventilation (EN-CV) für die Planung, den Bau, den Betrieb und die Wartung der Kühl- und Lüftungsanlagen für große energiephysikalische Beschleuniger, Experimente und technische Anlagen verantwortlich. Die EN-CV-Gruppe verfolgt nachhaltige Kühl- und Lüftungssysteme, die die Energieeinsparung und -rückgewinnung verbessern.

Sie treten der Projektabteilung (EN-CV-PJ) bei, die für die Koordination und das Management von Kühl- und Lüftungsprojekten für die Installation neuer Systeme, die Aufrüstung bestehender Systeme und die Konsolidierung alter Systeme sowohl für CERN-Beschleuniger als auch für Experimente zuständig ist.

Der Bereich ist für ganze Projektzyklen verantwortlich, angefangen von der Erfassung der Nutzeranforderungen bis hin zur endgültigen Inbetriebnahme von Kühl- und Lüftungssystemen.
Funktionen:

• Verfolgen und definieren Sie die Benutzeranforderungen der wichtigsten Stakeholder.

• Durchführung von Machbarkeitsstudien und detaillierten Entwürfen von industriellen Kühl- und HLK-Systemen, einschließlich Größen- und Kostenschätzungen für die vorgeschlagenen Lösungen.

• Schreiben Sie technische Berichte und Notizen.

• Erstellen Sie technische Spezifikationen und alle relevanten Dokumente, verfolgen Sie den Ausschreibungsprozess bis zur Entscheidung über zukünftige Verträge.

• Follow-up und regelmäßige Berichterstattung über den Fortschritt des Projekts.

• Gewährleistung der technischen Koordinierung und Überwachung der Auftragnehmer.

• Überwachen Sie Kosten und Zeitplan bis zur Inbetriebnahme und formellen Abnahme der Systeme.

• Unterstützung von Betriebsteams bei der Fehlersuche und Prozessverbesserung bestehender Anlagen.

• Aktiver Beitrag zur Entwicklung und Verbesserung der internen Verfahren, technischen Vorschriften und Standardisierung der technischen Lösungen.

• Master-Abschluss oder gleichwertige einschlägige Erfahrung im Bereich Maschinenbau oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Eine Zertifizierung im Projektmanagement (PMP/PMI) wäre ein Asset.
Erfahrung:

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Entwurf, Bau und Testen von industriellen Kühlsystemen, einschließlich Erfahrung bei der Auswahl der entsprechenden Geräte und Instrumente.

• Erste Erfahrungen in der Planung, Konstruktion und Erprobung von HLK-Anlagen und den zugehörigen Hydraulikkomponenten.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Vertragsmanagement.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Projektmanagement.
Technische Kompetenzen:

• Planung und Bau von Kühlwassersystemen (Kühlturm, entmineralisiertes und gekühltes Wasser) und Netzen einschließlich Prüfung von Anlagen und der zugehörigen Ausrüstung.

• Entwurf und Bau von HLK-Anlagen und -Netzen: einschließlich Prüfung der Anlage und der zugehörigen Ausrüstung.

• Wasserkühlung Prozessgestaltung und Analyse: sowie HVAC-Prozess.

• Projektmanagement.

• Vertragsmanagement.
Verhaltenskompetenzen:

• Ergebnisse erzielen: Einen strukturierten und organisierten Ansatz für die Arbeit haben; in der Lage sein, Prioritäten zu setzen und Aufgaben unter Berücksichtigung der Ergebnisse zu planen.

• Effektiv kommunizieren: Sicherstellen, dass Informationen, Verfahren und Entscheidungen angemessen dokumentiert werden.

• Demonstrieren von Flexibilität: leicht neue Techniken und Arbeitspraktiken aufnehmen; neue oder verbesserte Arbeitsweisen vorschlagen.

• Selbstmanagement: gut autonom arbeiten; Aktivitäten und Aufgaben übernehmen, ohne zu veranlassen.

• Arbeiten in Teams: Verstehen, wann Teamarbeit erforderlich ist, um die besten Ergebnisse zu erzielen; andere entsprechend einbeziehen und Informationen austauschen.
Sprachkenntnisse:

• Englisch gesprochen und geschrieben, mit der Verpflichtung, Französisch zu lernen.

Förderfähigkeit und Stichtag:
Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein integraler Bestandteil der Mission des CERN und ist ein fester Wert der Organisation. Die Beschäftigung einer vielfältigen Belegschaft ist zentral für unseren Erfolg. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen aus allen Mitgliedstaaten und assoziierten Mitgliedstaaten.
Diese freie Stelle wird so schnell wie möglich besetzt, und Anträge sollten uns normalerweise spätestens am 19.08.2026 um 23:59 Uhr erreichen.
Beschäftigungsbedingungen:
Vertragsart: Befristeter Vertrag (4 Jahre). Unter bestimmten Bedingungen können Inhaber von befristeten Verträgen eine unbefristete Position beantragen.
Arbeitszeit: 40 Stunden pro Woche
Arbeitsplatzflexibilität: Vollständig vor Ort
Diese Position umfasst:

• Arbeiten in Strahlungsgebieten.

• Eingriffe in unterirdische Anlagen.

• Ein gültiger Führerschein.

• Arbeiten in den Nächten, Sonntagen und offiziellen Feiertagen, wenn es die Bedürfnisse der Organisation erfordern.

• Schichtarbeit, wenn es die Bedürfnisse der Organisation erfordern.

• Bereitschaftsdienst, wenn es nach den Bedürfnissen der Organisation erforderlich ist.

• Exposition gegenüber dem Risiko eines Sturzes aus der Höhe während der Gerüstmontage und Demontage.

• Exposition gegenüber elektromagnetischen Feldern unter bestimmten Expositionsbedingungen.

• Schichtarbeit.

• Angesichts der mit dieser Position verbundenen beruflichen Gesundheitsrisiken muss der ausgewählte Kandidat eine ärztliche Genehmigung einholen, bevor ein Vertragsangebot bestätigt wird.
Job Grade: 6-7
Berufsbezeichnung: EN-CV-PJ-2026-162-LD
Arbeitsgebiet: Maschinenbau
Benchmark Job Title: Maschinenbauingenieur

Globale Vorteile

• Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt (steuerfrei), das im Einklang mit Ihrer jahrelangen relevanten Erfahrung steigt.

• 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr plus 2 Wochen jährliche Schließung.

• Deckung durch die umfassende Krankenversicherung des CERN (für Sie, Ihren Ehepartner und Ihre Kinder) und die Mitgliedschaft in der CERN-Pensionskasse.

• Familien-, Kinder- und Säuglingszulagen, abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

• Ein Umzugspaket (Installationszuschuss, Umzug, Reisekosten) abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

• Möglichkeit, Ihren Vertrag bis zu 8 Jahre + Anspruch auf unbefristete Vertragsdauer zu verlängern.
Überblick über CERN - Entdecken Sie eine Welt, in der das Unmögliche möglich gemacht wird!
Bei CERN, der Europäischen Organisation für Kernforschung, erweitern wir die Grenzen von Wissenschaft und Technologie. Unsere bahnbrechende Arbeit bringt nicht nur Physiker zusammen, sondern auch eine Vielzahl von Fachleuten aus den Bereichen Ingenieurwesen, Technik, Wissenschaft und Verwaltung. Gemeinsam fördern wir ein Umfeld, in dem Innovation und Zusammenarbeit gedeihen.
Jeden Tag stehen wir vor spannenden neuen Herausforderungen und Möglichkeiten, einen Beitrag zur Spitzenforschung zu leisten, die unser Verständnis des Universums prägt. Wir begegnen diesen Herausforderungen durch die vielfältigen Perspektiven in unseren Teams, stellen sicher, dass jeder Beitrag wertgeschätzt wird und fördern unser gemeinsames Gefühl von Inklusion und Zweck. Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein zentraler Wert des CERN und bleibt für unsere Mission und unseren anhaltenden Erfolg von zentraler Bedeutung.
Wenn Sie bereit sind, Teil einer dynamischen, integrativen Gemeinschaft zu sein, die die Grenzen des Wissens überschreitet, ist CERN der Ort, an dem Ihre Neugier und Ihre Fähigkeiten gedeihen können. Seien Sie Teil unserer Mission, das aufzudecken, was im Herzen des Universums liegt! TEIL!
